name: Jaws
description: Jaws pinball rules: how to start Shark Encounters, build the machete multiplier, capture all four bounty sharks, and reach the Smile You Son of a wizard mode.

body.text: Keith Elwin's JAWS puts you in Amity Island's summer of terror: rescue beachgoers, hunt bounty sharks, attach barrels to the Great White, and finally blow him up in "Smile, You Son of a…". The layout has no scoops or saucers — everything is flow: two main flippers, a mid-right mini flipper, five "beach" shots (left orbit = West Beach, Wave ramp = Marina, center ramp = North Beach, fishing reel = The Pond, right ramp = East Beach), a harpoon lane hugging the left wall, a Chum Bucket Newton ball, a center captive ball/bash boat, and the star mech: a **motorized Shark Fin drop target** that swims across the mid-playfield. Premium/LE adds the **Orca upper playfield** (Lookout Tower ramp, ship's-wheel spinner, Radio target) fed by the Wave ramp, plus a motorized shark that crashes up through Ben Gardner's boat; the Pro's Wave ramp instead returns to the mini flipper, fueling the quickshot loop.
Core loops

**Shark Encounters (modes).** Hit the bash boat to light an encounter, then start it at its beach shot. Extra boat hits first bank **boosts** — L1 +15s, L2 +5M + Gear, L3 **2x scoring for the whole mode**. Shoot blue shots to progress; finishing lights an **Encounter Jackpot at the fin** worth 20–50% of your mode total plus a **permanent +1x machete**. Value order: Scars > Raft Attack > Beach Panic > Night Swim > Pond Attack. Starting all five lights the **4th of July** mini-wizard.

**Jaws Multiballs (barrels).** No physical locks — "locking" means attaching barrels: feed the chum line (Chum Bucket + red left-flipper shots), raise the fin via yellow shots, and bash it. One barrel starts **Reel Him In!**, two starts **The Chase** (90+ switches light 20M captive-ball supers), three starts **Cage Dive**, whose completion qualifies the final wizard. MB1 is a utility multiball — stack it with Night Swim or Beach Panic.

**Bounty Hunts.** Spin the fishing reel to light hunts, complete each shark's tasks, and start at the reel: **Mako** (easiest — take it first for the 2x-reel perk), **Thresher**, **Hammerhead**, **Tiger**. Green shots and shark bashes wear the shark to a final capture shot. All four captures — or selling all six Gear pieces — qualify the 6-ball **Great White Multiball**.

**Beachgoers & Search/Rescue.** Shark tower standups light beachgoers at beach shots; three rescued at one beach starts a **Beach Closed hurry-up** (15M+ base, escalating). The 8th beachgoer is an extra ball; closing all five beaches offers the choice of **Rescue** or **Search Multiball** (mini-wizards).

**Quickshots & Gear.** Rolling the mini-flipper lane lights the harpoon lane blue; harpoon → quickly hit the fin = a Quickshot (3M + 200K/beachgoer, consecutive multiplier to 7x, **3 = extra ball**, each lights Gear). Gear (collected at the right ramp) gives six consumable perks — Binoculars, Oxygen Tank, Tracker, Barrel Hook, Shark Cage, Dart — or hoard all six unused and **sell for up to 375M**.
Multipliers

There is no global playfield X. The **machete** is the engine: complete the left 3-bank, roll a lit inlane, and your **next shot** is multiplied (base 2x; permanent +1x per completed encounter, most bounty captures, and Night Search completion; at 4x+ base the harpoon gate must relight it). Spend machetes on beach-closed hurry-ups, encounter jackpots, Pipit, and Feeding Frenzy finishers. Add the quickshot multiplier (to 7x), encounter 2x boosts, and bonus X from **Quint's Challenge** knots (timed combos lit after spelling O-R-C-A on the Wave ramp).
Other features

Seven single-ball **Character Combos** (Chrissie Watkins, Pipit, Alex Kintner, Ben Gardner, Scout Leader, Sam Quint, Goat) each add +250K to future Beach Closed shots. **Fish Finder** (left 3-bank) awards Super Buoys, Super Life Ring, Cast 'N Catch, the Shark Hunter video mode, and Night Search Multiball — all five light **Super Cast 'N Catch**. **Feeding Frenzy** (shark tower sets) builds bonus. The **Life Ring** (target-lit, action-button save) rescues left-outlane drains; **Flip-Lock** holds a ball on the mini flipper during multiball.
Wizard path

Mini-wizards: 4th of July (all 5 encounters), Search/Rescue MB (all beaches closed), Great White MB (4 sharks or gear sell-out), Super Cast 'N Catch (all Fish Finder awards), and Say Ah! (Prem/LE, all 5 Orca wheel awards). The **final wizard, "Smile, You Son of a…"**, requires completing Cage Dive: three timed phases (Quint's Demise, Clash on the Mast, the fin-and-targets finale) ending with one last shark hit — victory launches the 6-ball **Super Celebration Multiball**.
Stern continues tuning values as new code ships.

name: Pulp Fiction
description: Pulp Fiction pinball rules: the five objectives, the Big Kahuna 6x playfield multiplier, Drive Fast MPH scoring, and reaching the Divine Intervention wizard.

body.text: Chicago Gaming Company / Play Mechanix, 2023. Playfield by Mark Ritchie, rules by Josh Sharpe, sound by David Thiel (250+ real movie lines). A deliberately retro, single-level 1980s-style layout: **no ramps, no upper flippers** — two flippers, three pops (Jack, Rabbit, Slim's), two orbit spinners, seven drop targets, a grab magnet, and two physical 3-ball locks (back-panel briefcase trough and under-playfield subway). Ships as Special Edition and "Bad Mother Flipper" LE; **rules are identical across editions**.
Skill Shot

Five arrows light in sequence above the top **Starts Character saucer**. A full plunge drops into the saucer: 3k per lit arrow, **100k with all five lit**, and any drop-in starts a character. Holding the **left flipper** while plunging is the Super Skill Shot: all five Payoff shots light, any one within the timer scores 100k. Never plunge soft — weak plunges dribble back down the right orbit.
The Five Objectives (each lights an insert toward the wizard mode)

items: **Briefcase Boogie** — clear the 3 inline drops in the left lane, then shoot the popper to lock (3 locks = 3-ball multiball). Payoffs at the other four major shots climb red 25k → yellow 50k → green 75k; relock the balls for **blue Super Payoffs (250k)**. All four Supers restart the multiball at 2x.

**Pawn Shop Panic** — knock down the center 3-bank to open the scoop, lock 3 in the subway (bank resets each lock). In multiball, three drop hits light the scoop payoff; climb red/yellow/green to **blue Super Payoffs: all five major shots at 100k, endlessly relighting**. Payoff level carries across attempts — the beginner's multiball.

**Roll Scene** — hit the right drop target to qualify a scene (also lights outlane ball saves), then the saucer to start a **40-second movie scene**: Twist Contest (pops), BMF Wallet (seven red-arrow targets), Gold Watch (Bullseye Magnet target, 100k+/hit), Clean the Car (spinners). Sling/pop hits cycle the lit scene. **Collect at the saucer in the final 10 seconds** — the collect re-awards all previous scene collects too, the compounding "key to insane scores." All four scenes done unlocks **The Shot**: untimed 4-ball multiball where every drop-target hit pays 10% of your accumulated scene value.

**Cast Chaos** — the top saucer starts characters; the Roll Scene saucer collects all flashing ones at once (award x up to 5x). The upper-left **Hold Cast** standup carries them across balls. All five characters = 4-ball multiball: five 100k Payoffs, then the top saucer for a **500k Super Payoff**, relighting.

**Pulp Fiction Frenzy** — each completed red-arrow bank (left 2, center 3, right 2) spots a letter; 11 letters spell PULP FICTION. Shoot the Pawn Shop scoop for a 4-ball frenzy: **5k per switch**, ~10 switches per letter, 500k scoop payoff on every re-spell.

body.text: Multipliers & Award Systems

items: **Big Kahuna (playfield X)**: hit both Big Kahuna standups by the pops, then the **Bullseye Magnet target** — 2x ALL scoring for the rest of the ball, repeatable to 6x. Single-ball play only: build it first, then spend it on a scene or multiball. The magnet target is the game's signature risk/reward — clean hits are caught safely, misses rebound at the drain.

**Bonus X / Gun Bonus**: completing the 1-2-3-4 lanes (lane-change with flippers) advances Bonus X (max 10x; 6x lights Extra Ball) and starts the **Royale with Cheese** hurry-up at the yellow left standup. Cashing the hurry-up lights **Collect Gun Bonus** at the magnet target — a mid-ball bank of the end-of-ball bonus (max ~160k) multiplied by Bonus X *and* Kahuna X. Collecting resets both.

**Drive Fast**: a lit inlane briefly lights the opposite orbit; chained loops score 20k up to 100k while spinner spins add escalating MPH (+1 to +5 per spin). Cash **1,000 x MPH** at the hidden target behind the Pawn Shop drops; 146+ MPH lights Extra Ball. IFPA's Drive Fast Challenge record: 1,908 MPH collected at 3x for 5.7M in one shot.
**Outlane saves**: Roll Scene drop hits light left then right outlane saves (max 2/ball; a single save alternates on sling hits).

body.text: Divine Intervention (Wizard)

Light all five objective inserts, then start at the Roll Scene saucer or Briefcase lane. Six stages of 4-ball multiball that renews each stage: Briefcase lane x6, scoop x3, Roll Scene drop x5, top saucer x5, all seven red arrows, then — with no more ball renewal — the Bullseye Magnet target. Completion **doubles your entire score**; draining all balls fails and resets every objective.
Core Strategy

Kahuna X first, insurance early (backhand the right drop target), then stack the multiplier onto Gold Watch collects, Drive Fast MPH cash-outs, multiplied Gun Bonus banks, or safe multiball Super Payoff laps.

name: Godzilla
description: Godzilla pinball rules: destroy four cities, win Kaiju Battles, build the Destruction Jackpot multiplier, and climb the wizard ladder to King of the Monsters.

body.text: Designed by Keith Elwin, *Godzilla* is a campaign-style machine built around destroying four cities (Tokyo, New York, London, Paris), fighting a roster of kaiju, and chasing the game's signature **Destruction Jackpot**. It ships in Pro, Premium, and LE editions; all three share 3 flippers (including an upper-right flipper) and 1 pop bumper. Premium/LE add a powered building elevator that physically locks 3 balls, a rotating Mechagodzilla toy with a magnetic-chest ball-lock, and a breakaway **Bridge** ramp (a 3rd ramp). Pro has 2 ramps and routes Bridge Attack through the right ramp instead.
The core loop

Play is organized as a **city campaign**. Each city has an objective tracker on the Monster Monitor — **RAID** (start a Kaiju Battle), **POWER** (complete the Tesla/Powerline targets), **BRIDGE** (destroy the bridge), and **TANKS** (Tank Attack). Completing these across cities is the spine of wizard-mode qualification. Conquering a city grants +1 Bonus X, +1x on the Super Spinner, and a scaling award. Leaving a city banks the **Carnage Bonus**.
Kaiju Battles (RAID)

Shoot **either ramp twice** to light a Kaiju Battle at the **scoop**, where flippers + the action button pick the fight. The four Tier-1 monsters are: - **Gigan** — eight ramp shots, any mix (the safest battle; alternating ramps combo 2x/4x). - **Megalon** — hit a random flashing shot before a ~10s window closes; miss and he hides (shoot a ramp to recall). - **Ebirah** — a spinner battle across the three spinners; final blow at the pop bumper. - **Titanosaurus** — five targets in strict sequence (three Powerlines left-to-right, Maser Cannon, Magna-Grab captive ball); the precision battle.

Winning conquers the current city and adds +1x to the Destruction-Jackpot multiplier. **Tier-2 battles** (Ghidorah/Gigan/Megalon match-ups, some 3-ball multiballs) unlock as you rotate cities, several using the classic **"Fight or Flee"** risk/reward decision. Winning two Kaiju Battles awards an Extra Ball.
The five regular multiballs

items: **Godzilla Multiball** (cornerstone, 3-ball) — damage the building to 0% integrity with ramps (upper floors) and building shots (lower floors), then start at the building. Six jackpots light the Super Jackpot; scoring it qualifies the **Monster Zero** mini-wizard.

**Mechagodzilla Multiball** (3-ball) — spin the right spinner to deploy (~20 spins), knock down the three Neo-Barrier shield targets, start at the right spinner. Its Super Jackpot qualifies **Terror of Mechagodzilla**.
**Bridge Attack Multiball** (2-ball) — switch hits light Bridge Attack at the Magna-Grab captive ball; four attacks destroy the bridge, then "Bridge Out!" on either ramp starts it.
**Tank Attack Multiball** (2-ball) — destroy ~10 tanks via lit TANK shots; starts at the scoop. Tanks advance toward Godzilla on a timer, dropping the Super multiplier if they arrive.
**Saucer Attack Multiball** — destroy 6 saucers via the pop-bumper feature; the next bumper hit starts it, and each Saucer Jackpot adds a ball.

body.text: Award and collect systems

The **Destruction Jackpot** is the big-points chase: shoot the building when lit, then bank it on the upper loop. Its multiplier is fed by battles, saucer/Jet-Fighter thresholds, loops, and combos — but it **resets when you change city**, so cash before switching. Other systems include **Jet Fighter Attack** (inlane missiles → hurry-ups), **Trains** (left-ramp train-wreck; Prem/LE 5th train = Super Train Loops, Pro = 50M), **Monster Rampage** (spell R-A-M-P-A-G-E at the left spinner), **Magna-Grab / Imposter Battle** (magnet capture released for 5x loops or a left-spinner award up to 250M), **Hedorah**, and dozens of **City/Secret Combos**.
Allies and multipliers

**Allies** are lit at the halfway point of any battle (and via the Super Secret skill shot, Jet-Fighter milestones, etc.), cycled with the right flipper and collected at the scoop: **Rodan** (2x playfield, the only whole-playfield multiplier, ~60s), **Mothra** (left-outlane save), **Anguirus** (action-button add-a-ball). Other multipliers: **Bonus X** (+1 per conquered city), in-mode shot color ladders, and the **Super Spinner** — the first center-spinner rip after firing **Heat Ray** scores 2x/spin +1x per conquered city. Heat Ray itself is charged on the center spinner and, when the meter fills, held-and-released to collect everything currently lit (disabled during Planet X and Tier-2 battles).
Skill shots

Every skill shot scores points and adds ball-save time, and each *unique* type raises the multiplier on all of them — variety beats repetition. Easy ones feed the pop bumper; the money shots sit near the upper flipper. The best is the **Super Secret Skill Shot**: full plunge into the left spinner lane, then reflex to the scoop for ~10M, 2 Power-Ups, and an instant Ally.
Power-Ups and wizard modes

**Godzilla Power-Ups** are earned from dozens of tasks and collected at the scoop (choose 1 of 2). They gate the wizard modes: level 4 lights Monster Zero or Terror of Mechagodzilla (given the matching multiball Super Jackpot), level 8 lights **King of the Monsters**. The wizard ladder runs: the two mini-wizards → **Planet X Multiball** (complete all four city objectives) → **King of the Monsters** (final wizard: all four monsters at once, then a 4-ball bounty multiball) → **Monster Island Madness** (ultra-wizard: a 75-second 6-ball frenzy).
Recommended play

The consensus opener is the **Gigan ramp line**: plunge for a skill shot, shoot both ramps to light the scoop, start Gigan, and loop ramps — the safest path, which simultaneously damages the building toward Godzilla Multiball. Grab **Mothra** first for outlane insurance, hold **Rodan** for your biggest scoring window, spend **Heat Ray** whenever the playfield is well-lit, and cash the Destruction Jackpot **before** changing cities.

name: Pokémon
description: Pokemon pinball rules: catch Pokemon at the Pokedex captive ball, win Rival Battles, run Team Rocket Multiball, and reach the Pikachu vs Charizard wizard mode.

body.text: Designed by George Gomez and Jack Danger on Stern's SPIKE 3 platform (revealed Feb 12 2026), Pokémon is a two-flipper game built around **three parallel scoring paths** that a top score must feed together: **Story Modes**, **Catching Pokémon + Rival Battles**, and **Team Rocket Multiball**. The single most important physical shot is the **Pokédex triple captive ball** — it scans caught Pokémon, finishes story modes, and cashes out combos. Treat it as the hub. Editions are Pro / Premium / LE (750 units); rules are identical across all three, with Premium/LE adding an animatronic Pikachu, an animatronic ball-lock Poké Ball, the Squirtle Whirlpool, a Psyduck Sneak-In scoop, and a chaos-inducing battle-arena electromagnet.
The Playfield

The four major shots each map to a starter: **Left Orbit = Bulbasaur**, **Left Ramp = Squirtle** (the steepest shot, backhandable through a one-way gate), **Right Ramp = Pikachu** (encircles the Pikachu toy), and **Right Orbit = Charmander** (fronted by an optical spinner, the fastest route into the Tall Grass pop bumpers). The center **Battlefield** holds two 3-banks that spell **B-A-T-T-L-E**, a gated **center lane**, and the **Meowth balloon** bash toy. To the right sits the **Town Scoop** (Rival Battles, Mystery, Travel, Extra Balls). Berry targets (two flanking the left ramp, one by the Pokédex) arm 2× Playfield; training targets heal and extend timers.
Skill Shots

items: **Standard:** full plunge into the flashing top lane for +2× bonus multiplier (base 500k). The tutorial-preferred default because the ball then drops into the bumpers, the main way to spawn Pokémon.

**Super:** hold the left flipper and hit any flashing shot off the plunge (2× value, base 1M). Into the center lane it instantly completes BATTLE and lowers the balloon; into the scoop it lights a mystery.
**Secret:** bounce into Psyduck for 3× value (base 1.5M).

body.text: Story Modes

Each starts by hitting its home shot **3×** and finishes at the captive ball; each completion awards a **shot multiplier** and adds a ball to the Charizard wizard. **Bulbasaur** lights ramps/orbits for pollen (clearing a set without the berry = +1× bonus X). **Squirtle** spins the whirlpool and raises a blue-shot multiplier up to 4×. **Pikachu vs. Raichu** is a 2-ball multiball — collect 3 captive-ball super jackpots; it is the easiest and most valuable opener. **Charmander** rips the spinner for 100 spins with a jackpot multiplier up to 4×.
Catching and Rival Battles

Fill the Discover gauge at the bumpers/top lanes to spawn a Pokémon, **scan** it at the captive ball to start the **CATCH! hurry-up** (base ~2M), spell C-A-T-C-H on purple shots, then **capture at the left ramp** (value = combined purple-shot value). Catches gate **Rival Battles**, started at the Town Scoop: hit flashing shots and Battlefield targets to deal damage, cash **faint jackpots** at the center lane (multiplied per Pokémon defeated), and grab the **victory bonus** at the left ramp within ~10s. Keeping your party alive so the faint-jackpot multiplier compounds across battles is the game's biggest sustained points engine. Travel between biomes (Forest → Lake/Desert/Mountain) unlocks by discovering+catching, completing training targets, playing a battle, and completing all four story modes.
Team Rocket Multiball

Spell **BATTLE** to lower the Meowth balloon, **bash it 3×** (+2 each subsequent MB), then hit the lane beneath it to start. **6 jackpots** light a super jackpot (worth the jackpot total) that qualifies a shot multiplier and opens ~15–20s of unlimited super jackpots; the next cycle needs 8. **Add-a-ball:** re-spell BATTLE during multiball and press the action button while it blinks green — the core expert tactic for keeping the multiball alive. MB2 (\"Mecha-Meowth\") introduces freeze/thaw jackpot-multiplier mechanics.
Multipliers

items: **Shot Multipliers (2×):** earned by completing a story mode or the first Team Rocket super jackpot. Applies 2× to everything the next major shot scores (mode values, CATCH! hurry-up, Eevee combo third shots) for the rest of the ball. Once all shots hold a 2×, the next qualifies at 3×. Priority: left ramp, then right-orbit spinner.
**2× Playfield (Berries):** left berry ×2 + right berry ×2 + flashing center berry = 20s of doubled scoring; hitting the center berry during it adds +5s (cap 20s). Layer it over any big window.
**Bonus X:** built on the top lanes (+2× per standard skill shot), caps at 20×, multiplies end-of-ball bonus.

body.text: Combos and Awards

Combos register by shooting the four ramps/orbits in quick succession; each shot awards a Poké Ball (+1 if TEAM-boosted), and a 2-way-or-greater combo lights the captive ball to cash Poké Balls equal to combo length. The headline system is the **eight Eeveelution combos** — preset 3-shot sequences (e.g., Espeon = Right Ramp → Left Ramp → Captive Ball) scoring 2.5M + 500k each, with all eight worth 10M and resetting for repeat play. **50 Poké Balls** or **25 captive-ball hits** light an extra ball at the scoop. **TEAM** lanes arm timed sub-modes (Pikachu Hurry-Up, Squirtle Prize Pool, Charmander Super Spinner, Bulbasaur Loops) that boost a shot's value for the rest of the ball.
Wizard Modes

Completing all four story modes lights **Pikachu vs. Charizard** at the right ramp — a 2–6 ball multiball of four phases (base = 10% of each story mode's score) ending in a center-lane super jackpot capped at 100M (200M with 2× playfield), with a Last Chance ball-add. The catch/battle path leads toward the **Lucario** challenge and the Team Rocket path toward the **Arena/Mewtwo** challenge; both remain TBD in current code (~0.81–0.83). Scores typically settle around 100M–200M, with strong players breaking a billion.

name: King Kong: Myth of Terror Island
description: King Kong pinball rules: spell KING KONG for letters and perks, run King Kong Multiball, climb for height bonus, and battle through to 8th Wonder of the World.

body.text: Keith Elwin's follow-up to JAWS/Godzilla/Jurassic Park, released spring 2025 in **Pro (~$6,999)**, **Premium (~$9,699)** and **LE (~$12,999, 932 units** honoring Kong's 1932 debut). The code is still pre-1.0 as of this writing, so exact point values may shift, but the mechanics below are stable. Roughly **100M is an average game; 300M+ wins tournaments.**
Layout at a glance

A **four-flipper** playfield: two lower flippers with a rare **center post** between them, a full **upper-right flipper** fed by the cliffs ramp, and an upper-left **mini-flipper** serving the drops, river lane and cliffs ramp. There are **no pop bumpers**. Drain geometry is unusual — the left outlane sits *between* the two left inlanes. The **plunge feeds the top-left**, so every skill shot targets left-side features. Key shots: the **Gong** bash target (summons Kong, starts island scenes; Pro lights it via white island arrows), **center ramp** (Kong locks/Kombos), **Spider Pit** (magnet + spider sculpt), **cliffs ramp**, **side ramp**, **biplane helix ramp**, **left/right orbits** with optical spinners, **river lane / Log Bridge** (action-button diverter), **punchback** kicking target, **Lost Temple 4-bank drops** with a hidden Island Treasure target, and the far-right **Kong Cave VUK**.
Skill shots

Each **unique** skill shot instantly spots a KING KONG letter and adds ball-save time, so collecting a different variant every ball is the most efficient early currency. Variants: Skill (pit), Super (river), Anti (left outlane), Secret (inner-left inlane), Super Secret (outer-left inlane), **Mega Secret** (mini-flipper reflex to cliffs, 1.75M, 2×/3× with a biplane/U-turn follow-up), Double Mega, and **Ultra Secret** (cliffs → cross-field river, ~7M). A weak plunge that dribbles back grants a **Sneak-In** re-attempt.
Spelling KING KONG (8 letters)

Letters come from unique skill shots, gong hits, cliffs shots, Pterodactyl cave awards and a flawless Super Sweep. Set 1 perks arm next-shot 2× multipliers (cliffs, river, pit) and light Deadeye (Pro at "G", Prem/LE at "O"); the 8th letter lights **T-Rex Battle**. A second full spell lights **Boss T-Rex** (4-ball multiball).
Multiballs

items: **King Kong Multiball** — the #1 tournament multiball. Complete the KONG drops to lock at the center ramp; the third lock starts it (Prem/LE: Kong flips the NYC train car; Pro uses virtual locks + right-orbit start). Cash the **side-ramp super**, use **cliffs = 2×**, and **relock at the center ramp for 2× all jackpots (20s)**.

**Spider Pit Multiballs** — four total; the first three are creature battles (**Giant Spider** is the best earner, max 25M × 4). The fourth is **Spider Queen** (super at the pit; an 8th Wonder objective).
**Lost Temple Multiball** — earned via the Heart of the Keepers treasure through the drop-target cipher system.

body.text: Modes

Five 60-second **Island Scenes** (Save Ann, Cross the Chasm, Pterodactyl Attack, Stegosaurus Encounter, Escape the Swamp), all started at the gong; playing/completing them feeds **8th Wonder** and yields map segments. **Crash the Gate** is the 6th-scene mini-wizard. Climbing to 200/500 ft lights **Island Locks** that upgrade a scene to a 2-ball multiball. **NYC Events** (Stage Fright, Window Shopping, Manhattan Rampage) light at the right orbit after clearing climb shots and each carry one of three single-use scoring modifiers.
Combos ("Kombos")

The core money system: chain major shots to build a **2→5-way Kombo**, which lights the **Powerup target** — cash it for **(sum of Kombos) × Kombo length, up to 100M**, plus stacked timed buffs. Disabled in multiball. Named combos: **Super Sweep** (left orbit through the drops → side ramp = 10M, or 50M + a letter for all four), **Ricochet** (right return → cliffs = 5M), and Biplane combos **Barrel Roll** and **Chandelle Maneuver**. **Super Spinners** (alternating orbit rips, 25M each) is the safest farm.
Climbing, treasures & multipliers

"Always be climbing" — height lights Island Locks, NYC events, an extra ball, and a large end-of-ball bonus term. **Map segments** feed Treasure Hunts at the Kong Cave; **2× playfield scoring** is lit by the four orange X targets + the roving X. **Bonus X** builds at the drops. End-of-ball bonus = (100 × switches) + (2,500 × height) + (150,000 × letters), all × Bonus X.
Wizard modes

Mini-wizards: **Crash the Gate**, **T-Rex Battle**, **Boss T-Rex**. The main wizard **"8th Wonder of the World"** is qualified by filling six gate objectives (Island Scenes, Climbing, NYC Events, Biplane Attack, King Kong MB, Spider Pit/Queen), each with L1 and L2 tiers.
Editions

Rules are identical across editions; only mechs differ. **Premium/LE** add the physical NYC train-car lock, the animatronic Kong, and the river log-bridge diverter, plus two KING KONG letter-timing tweaks (Deadeye at "O", each Save Ann gong enters the VUK). **Pro** uses virtual locks and white island arrows. **LE** adds cosmetic/AV upgrades only.

name: Attack from Mars
description: Attack from Mars pinball rules: destroy the Martian saucers before starting multiball, stack Total Annihilation, and reach the Rule the Universe wizard mode.

body.text: **Attack from Mars** (Bally 1995, designed by Brian Eddy with software by Lyman Sheats) is a fast, open "fan" layout where every major shot radiates from two standard lower flippers. There is no upper flipper, no spinner, and no captive ball. The Chicago Gaming Company 2017 remake ships in **Classic, Special, and Limited** editions, but all three run the **identical original ruleset** — editions differ only in trim, lighting, display, and topper. The only meaningful gameplay variable is code version (v1.13 changes Stroke of Luck for tournaments).
The Layout

Left to right, the five "fan" shots are the **Left Orbit (Capture)**, **Left Ramp (Big-O-Beam)**, **Center/Lock Ramp**, **Right Ramp (Tractor Beam)**, and **Right Orbit (Atomic Blaster)**. Dead center sits the signature **flying-saucer toy**, guarded by a motorized 3-target **force field**; behind it are a rear **drop target** and a **sinkhole**. Around the playfield are green **M-A-R-T-I-A-N** standups, three **jet bumpers** feeding the **Stroke of Luck scoop**, and **top Bonus X lanes** above the jets.
Skill Shots

The **regular skill shot** feeds the top lanes — steer the flashing light onto the ball's lane for points and **+5X bonus multiplier**. The **Super Skill Shot** (hold the left flipper on launch) routes the ball down the left orbit; hit any major shot within ~2 seconds for **50M and an instant award spot** on that shot.
Attack Waves & Conquer Mars — the spine

Not timed and persistent across drains, Attack Waves are the heart of the game. Knock down the force field, damage the exposed saucer via the drop target, then shoot the sinkhole to destroy it. Values escalate: **1st saucer = 200M, then +100M each** (up to the 5th). Destroy all five cities (Washington, Berlin, London, Rome, Paris) to open **Mars** — 10 hits at 100M, the **10th destroys Mars for 2.5 billion**. Afterward every saucer hit pays a flat 100M for the rest of the game. Golden rule: **saucers are worth more than jackpots, and you must start a wave BEFORE multiball** so saucer destruction stacks under jackpots.
Multiballs

items: **Multiball (3-ball):** lock three balls at the center ramp; all five major shots light for jackpots (60M, +10M). Collect all five to light a **roving Super Jackpot** (250M, +250M/super, cap 1B) that travels the shots with unlimited time.
**Martian Multiball (2-ball):** spell M-A-R-T-I-A-N, start Martian Attack at the scoop, then kill the four wiggling Martians. The only multiball during which **combos still count**.

**Total Annihilation (4-ball):** the money mode. Complete three lamps on each of the four TA shots; the 3rd lamp on each starts a saucer hurry-up that stacks **100M → 300M → 500M → 1B**, the fourth auto-starting TA. Inside, all shots stay lit; farm the safe right orbit and cash the **center-ramp Annihilation Super Jackpot** (sum of jackpots since the last super). Never scales harder — routinely ~2B.
**Strobe Multiball:** awarded by Stroke of Luck; the lights go dark and you bash the force field for 50M/hit (Extra Ball at 10, +250M at 20).

body.text: Stroke of Luck

Light the steerable inlane/outlane rollovers, then collect at the scoop for a mystery award (points, Light Extra Ball, Light Lock/Start Multiball, Start Attack Wave, +5X or Hold Bonus, Strobe Multiball, Video Mode, Sneak Attack, Martian Bombs). On **v1.13 code**, enabling the tournament/competition setting **neuters Stroke of Luck to a flat 50M award every time** — the headline change that makes v1.13 tournament-friendly.
Combos, Super Jets & Multipliers

Any ramp starts the generic combo counter; chain lit ramp/orbit/lock shots before the fixed timer expires. Orbits only continue a combo when their TA lamps are complete, the gate is open, and Super Jets is off. A **5-Way Combo** is a Rule the Universe objective. **Super Jets** lights at 100 jet hits (3M each). AFM has **no playfield multiplier** — the big multiplier is the **bonus X**, advanced via the top lanes and +5X skill shots (caps 250X), with Hold Bonus carrying it between balls. End-of-ball bonus = 5M + 250K per Martian destroyed, times the multiplier.
Wizard Mode — Rule the Universe

Complete six objectives in one game: a Super Jackpot, Total Annihilation, Martian Multiball, Conquer Mars, Super Jets, and a 5-Way Combo. Start at the scoop for a 4-5 ball multiball with a long ball saver where everything scores. Reach **5 billion** before draining to one ball to win a flat **+5 billion** and log your initials, then run Victory Laps on the lit combo arrows.
Strategy in Brief

Beginners should play control-first: bank +5X skill shots, feed the center ramp for Light Lock, and let Stroke of Luck start Attack Waves so you avoid the dangerous center. The high-EV opener is a Super Skill Shot into ramp progress, then destroying the first two saucers for the easiest Extra Ball. Tournament players farm Total Annihilation — make each TA shot 3x, stack the free billion, then loop the right orbit and cash center supers.

name: Stranger Things
description: Stranger Things pinball rules: play all 12 chapters, defeat the Demogorgon, run Telekinesis Multiball, and reach the Final Showdown grand wizard mode.

body.text: Brian Eddy's first Stern (after *Attack from Mars* and *Medieval Madness*), released December 2019 and based on Netflix Seasons 1–2. It's a two-flipper, six-ball, symmetric fan layout with **eight main shots**: left orbit, left ramp, left saucer/kicker, center (Demogorgon behind a 4-bank of drops), Burn It Back inner loop, right ramp, right orbit, plus the left standup/mystery lane as the utility/combo-ender. Three editions — **Pro / Premium / LE** — share the sculpted Demogorgon bash toy, drop-target guard, two hideout scoops, a Demodog spinner, and three ramps. **Premium/LE add** a first-ever Stern playfield video projector and Eleven's telekinetic **magnet ball lock** (the Pro locks balls mechanically at the left ramp instead); LE extras are cosmetic.
Skill Shots (chosen on plunge)

One drop roves the 4-bank at ball start. **Standard** = full plunge into the flashing drop (5M, +1M each). **Super** = soft-plunge toward the flippers then shoot the saucer (10M, +2.5M each) — safe and sets up a chapter. **MXV** = do both on one plunge, rebounding off the drop into the saucer (25M, +5M each, +1 Drawing).
The Six Objectives → Final Showdown

All six inserts must be solidly lit to reach the wizard mode: **5-Way Combo**, **Send It Back** (all 6 Season-1 chapters), **Demodog!** (all 3 Demodog modes), **Demogorgon!** (all 5 Demogorgon modes), **Light the Fire** (all 6 Season-2 chapters), and **Telekinesis Multiball** (collect its Super Jackpot).

**5-Way Combo:** chain five shots each within a few seconds. The first four are any mix/repeat of left orbit, left ramp, Burn It Back, right ramp; the 5th must be a terminal (saucer, left standup, center, or right orbit). It adds **+10M to end-of-ball bonus for the rest of the game** — grab it early.
Chapters (12: six Season 1 + six Season 2)

Start any chapter by lighting **three inserts on one main shot** (left orbit/left ramp = Season 1; right ramp/right orbit = Season 2), then shooting that shot. Pops cycle the selected chapter (left pop = S1, right pop = S2); the left standup can spot progress early. Each chapter awards +1 Drawing (+2 if you meet its restriction). Notable ones: **Where's Barb?** (saucer reveals the flashing shot), **Monster Hunting!** (five drop waves), **Operation Mirkwood** (ramp↔ramp combo, +1M per comboed ramp), **Save Will!** (fixed five-shot combo for ~50M), **Quarter Hunt!** (switch frenzy), **Lure Dart!** (raised by the Dart pop-bumper level).
Multiballs

items: **Telekinesis Multiball** (3-ball, priority): light the two green **Light Lock** standups flanking the left ramp, lock at the **left ramp** (safe, returns to left flipper), 3rd lock auto-starts. Collect 5 lit jackpots (~1.1M rising) then the **Super at the saucer** (~6M). Premium/LE relock a ball via the magnet for a 2x/3x Super.

**Demogorgon multiballs**: **Trap 'Em!** (2-ball), **Run Will!** (4-ball, raising ramp), **Can't Stop This!** (5-ball, 60s unlimited ball save, Super up to ~100M). Each is qualified by clearing the drop bank (one more clear per successive mode) and started at the Demogorgon mouth.

body.text: Demodog Modes (3)
Spell **D-E-M-O-D-O-G** on the standups (first can be spotted at the saucer), then play **Break Out!**, **Junk Yard!**, and **It's a Trap!** Completing all three lights the Demodog! objective.
Multipliers

items: **2x Playfield Scoring** (60s) lights at the **saucer** by Burn It Back loop counts (7, 18, then every +14). Cash it only over a live multiball + mode stack — the biggest single swing.

**Bonus X** (1x–5x) advances on **even** return-lane completions (odd completions light Mystery). Bonus carries over between balls and can dwarf live scoring, so cycle the inlanes to 5x before draining a loaded ball.

body.text: Burn It Back Loop

The most-farmed repeatable shot. Loops accumulate all game for an award ladder: **Extra Ball** (loops 1–10 and at 50), **Spell of Protection** outlane ball-save (3, 12, 25, then +14 — "like an extra ball"), and **2x Scoring** lit at the saucer (7, 18, then +14).
Drawings

Eleven's drawings are a game-long currency: each adds +10M to every wizard-mode starting jackpot and +2M to bonus; **11 Drawings lights an Extra Ball**. Earned from MXV skill shot, any chapter, each Demodog mode, the Telekinesis Super, Dart level 4, and a Mystery roll.
Wizard / Mini-Wizard Modes

All start on the **next left-ramp shot** and open with 10M per Drawing. **Total Isolation 1 & 2** qualify after playing chapters on all four main shots (once, then twice) — combo the lit jackpots to double them; the center scoop is the Super. **Send It Back** and **Light the Fire** are the season-completion mini-wizards. **Final Showdown** is the true wizard mode requiring all six objectives lit; completing it launches the **Snow Ball Dance** victory lap.
Strategy Summary

The safe geography is the left side: the **left ramp returns to the left flipper**, so open there to arm Telekinesis Multiball under ball-save, then take any stack (Chapter + Demodog + Telekinesis). Grab the 5-Way Combo early, never neglect Burn It Backs, save 2x Scoring for a stack, and max Bonus X before draining. **Avoid the Demogorgon center mouth** except when required or under multiball — it's the game's danger shot, and bricks kick straight down the middle.

name: John Wick
description: John Wick pinball rules: complete all seven Jobs, win the five Adversary Battles, stack enemy shot multipliers, and reach The Duel and Special Assignment.

body.text: **Designer:** Elliot Eismin. **Code:** Tim Sexton (pre-0.94), then Mike Vinikour. **Editions:** Pro / Premium / LE. Ian McShane narrates as Winston. The machine has **only two flippers** — the Red Circle "dance floor" up top is a non-flippered shoot-in arena.
The core loop

John Wick is a **video-game-style enemy** game layered on a job + battle structure. Enemies spawn from the Red Circle bumper and standup targets (roughly every 50 switch hits) and sit **in front of lit shots**, where each enemy acts as a **+1x shot multiplier (max 3 enemies = 4x)**. Defeating enemies is the single biggest scoring lever. The winning pattern everyone repeats: **spawn/kill enemies → each enemy multiplies job and multiball shots → stack a Job under a Multiball → cash out at the left eject.**
Jobs (7 factions)

Charge the **Weapons Crate / right VUK** until 3 blue lights are solid, shoot a **faction shot** to choose which job, then the VUK starts it. Each faction maps to a physical shot: Bowery/Night Watch (left eject), NY Continental/Assassination (left orbit), Osaka/Security Detail (left ramp), High Table/VIP Award (Red Circle), Ruska Roma/Heist (center ramp), Marquis de Gramont/Gather Intel (right orbit), Tarasov/Task a Crew (right ramp). Jobs run on a **60-sec base timer** (+3s per shot, +30s every 4th job) and **cash out at the left eject** for 20% of the job total plus a faction perk. **Gather Intel and Assassination** are the top point jobs; **Task a Crew** is played early for its **add-a-ball** perk. Play 3 jobs → extra ball; play all 7 → wizard mode **The Staircase**.
Multiballs

items: **Car Multiball** — bash the car to qualify (2 hits, 4 on Pro; +1 each subsequent), start at the **lit left orbit**. Four rotating variants: Helipad Showdown, Taxicab Chase, Motorcycle Pursuit, and the high-value **Bagarre à l'Étoile**. Base jackpot 2M, supers up to 5x. Pre-load the car jackpot with single-ball car bashes + spinner rips.

**Deconsecrated Multiball** — bash the **Continental captive ball** to spell **WINSTON**, lighting the center-ramp lock (virtual on Pro, physical on Prem/LE); lock 3 balls to start. Green jackpots scale with enemies; after 7 jackpots the captive ball opens a 15-sec **super jackpot** burst. Best multiball to stack with a job.

**Excommunicado Multiball** — build the Red Circle **dance-floor level** with the pop bumper and surrounding standups, then start with a Red Circle shot (or the VIP backdoor plunge if lit). 15-sec build phase → 2-ball MB → 5M+ super.

body.text: Adversary Battles (5, single-ball only)

Defeat **10 enemies in single-ball play** to light the left eject, then start a battle: **Viggo, Kirill, Cassian, Ares, Zero.** Timer 200 sec, 40-sec ball save; change target via left standups or pop bumper. Each level continued adds **+1x (max 4x)**; cash before you drain. **"Be Seeing You"** pays 25M + 10M bonus + first-time extra ball. **Cassian** (switch frenzy) stacked with Lights Out + Heist's motion-sensor perk can cash **500M+**. **Zero** is the combo battle. Play all 5 → wizard mode **The Duel**.
Combos

There is no global any-shot combo timer — combos are **naturally-flowing, non-repeated** lit shots. Key named combos: the **MXV skill shot** (right orbit → right ramp → left eject = 10M + 10 enemies), the **Gather Intel ramp combo** (left ↔ right ramp doubles the center-ramp jackpot), and **Zero** cashouts (chain blue shots, collect at the left eject for 2x). The **Task a Crew spinner loop** (right ramp arms the spinner at 2x, then rip the left-orbit spinner) is a top repeatable farm.
Multipliers

items: **BABA (bonus X):** right flipper cycles the right-inlane rollovers; spell BABA to step the end-of-ball bonus multiplier (max 5x). VIP Award perk starts it at 2x/ball.

**YAGA / Lights Out (playfield X):** left flipper cycles the left inlanes; a YAGA letter only lights where a BABA letter already is. Spell YAGA to light Lights Out, then hit the action button to **double all scoring for 30 sec**.
**Enemy shot multipliers:** the +1x-per-enemy layer above, up to 4x per shot.

body.text: Skill shots

Baba Yaga (clean plunge, 0 switches → crate VUK): 1.5M + auto-start a job. Super Crate / Crate for sloppier plunges. VIP backdoor: 650k+, and **starts Excommunicado** if lit. MXV combo: 10M + 10 enemies. Car skill (Prem/LE only): 850k+ toward Car MB.
Wizard modes (in order)

**Red Circle Reckoning** (mini — 1 job + 1 battle + one of each MB type), **The Staircase** (all 7 jobs), **The Duel** (all 5 battles), and **Special Assignment** (all 6 multiballs — a limited-flip finale that ends the game).
Editions

Pro uses virtual locks, a bash-only car, standup-target crate, and an open (plugged) Red Circle. **Premium/LE** add a physical Deconsecrated lock, a motorized/side-hittable ball-locking car, an opening weapons crate with a hidden shot, a motorized Blood Oath Marker, a controlled Red Circle drop target, 3-ball Car MB, and the Car skill shot. LE extras (lighting, backglass, shaker, armor) are cosmetic.

name: Dungeons & Dragons: The Tyrant's Eye
description: Dungeons & Dragons pinball rules: pick a class, clear campaign quests and Town Dungeons, run Gelatinous Cube and Dragon Multiball, and reach the wizard endings.

body.text: Designed by **Brian Eddy** (playfield) with code by **Dwight Sullivan**, released February 2025 in **Pro ($6,999)**, **Premium ($9,699)** and **LE ($12,999, 740 units** honoring D&D's 1974 origin). The theme is the Dragonshield Guild's campaign across Faerun to stop a dragon war led by **Tiamat**, with **Xanathar the beholder — "the Tyrant's Eye"** — as the concrete final boss.
Layout

A dense **three-flipper** playfield (two lower + one upper "third" flipper) with **no pop bumpers**, deliberately echoing Eddy's *The Shadow*. Cascading ramps and loops feed the upper flipper, and a central **Magnetic Narrow Path** grabs the ball for a slow, controlled upper-flipper setup. Key shots: **left orbit** (Gel Cube lock / damage), **right orbit** (starts Dragon MB), **left ramp** (right-flipper only), **Road to Town right ramp** (extra balls, choose-action), **side/bridge ramp**, **Red Cave upper loop** behind Rath, the central **Tiny's Tavern spinner**, the **3-bank standups** under **Rath the Relentless** (animatronic red dragon bash toy), **Fizmo's left eject**, the **Gelatinous Cube** electromagnet lock, a **Critical Hit captive ball**, **dungeon standups**, the **secret door** + **Hidden Temple** (2x scoring), and the between-flippers **Shield**. Premium/LE add a **pop-up dungeon scoop**, multi-axis Rath that spits balls, and 8-ball (vs 6-ball Pro) Dragon Multiball.
Multiballs

items: **Dragon Multiball**: spell **D-R-A-G-O-N** on the 3-bank, start at the right orbit (or side ramp). Loop 3-bank -> Rath for jackpots; four 1x jackpots light the **upper-loop super**. Defeat Rath before draining to continue into **Town Celebration Multiball** (500k jackpots, 4x side-loop super, 50%-off Fizmo).

**Gelatinous Cube Multiball**: lock via **left orbit -> left ramp** (1-4x, operator-set) at the cube magnet. Four rotating lit shots pay jackpots (5M, +3M each to 25M); all four light the **20M side-loop super**, which resets. Pros rate this the most lucrative multiball. Relights by completing any campaign mode.
**Tavern Brawl** (2-ball mini-wizard) and **Tiny's Dice** are the other multiball-adjacent modes.

body.text: Modes & Campaign

Pick a **class** and **starting city** at plunge. Each location has numbered quests (Orange/White/Blue/Purple, roughly level 1/2/3) plus a **Town Dungeon**, started from the yellow choose-action shot. Battles use **red-arrow damage shots** that roll a **d20 for each of four party members**; the **captive ball** twice = a **Natural 20 / Critical Hit** that spots shots or advances DRAGON/lock/2x progress. A **Dungeon Crawl** roguelike sub-game (lit at the dungeon standups, started at the spinner on Pro or the pop-up scoop on Prem/LE) explores procedural rooms for XP, gold, extra balls and legendary equipment.
Wizard Modes (the 3 campaign endings)

Reached by clearing a **Dragonspear Castle** or **Gauntlgrym** Town Dungeon and picking a branching CHOICE, then starting via **three blue shots** (side ramp / center / right ramp): **The Undermountain** (Xanathar boss, unlocks the Ranger), **Ritual of the Chosen** (five chromatic-dragon battles, unlocks the Bard), and **Rescue the King** (unlocks the Barbarian). Two mini-wizard modes — **Tiny's Dice Game** (3 modes to qualify) and **Tavern Brawl** (Dragon MB + Gel Cube MB + a Dungeon Crawl to qualify) — start at the center spinner.
Multipliers, Shield & Skill Shots

items: **Hidden Temple 2x**: hit the **secret-door target** then the Hidden Temple to bank **20 sec of 2x on all scoring** (+5s per re-hit). Stacking this over multiball is the single biggest score lever.
**Bonus X**: buy +1x / +3x items at Fizmo (end-of-ball bonus is otherwise modest).
**Shot multipliers**: jackpots ramp 1x -> 2x -> 3x in Dragon MB and Tavern Brawl.

**The Shield**: a post between the flippers raised with the action button when it flashes; charged by completing the return lanes. Beyond saving center drains, **shield-staging** the ball off the right flipper enables repeatable left-ramp loops — the game's core farming trick.

**Skill shots**: short plunge to upper loop or gelatinous-cube switch (2M x ball number); **Super Skill Shot** (left eject -> side ramp -> right ramp, 6M); **MXV** into the Hidden Temple (6M + lights 2x).

body.text: Strategy

There is **no traditional combo counter** — "combos" are really mode-based jackpot loops plus shield-staging. Tournament consensus: **focus on Tavern Brawl**, lighting it by playing Dragon MB, Gel Cube MB and a Dungeon Crawl; favor **Gelatinous Cube over Dragon Multiball** for value; stack **2x scoring** over everything; take extra balls (they permanently raise the skill-shot multiplier). Beginners should pick **Ardor (Paladin)** and open in **Arabel** or **Kobold Town**, banking the MXV skill shot and using captive-ball crits and ranged weapons to avoid risky shots. A good game clears **~200M**.
Editions

**Pro**: no pop-up scoop (spinner starts the crawl), single-axis Rath, 6-ball Dragon MB. **Premium/LE**: pop-up dungeon scoop, multi-axis ball-spitting Rath, 8-ball Dragon MB. The **Gelatinous Cube** and its electromagnet lock are on all three models, as are the Magnetic Narrow Path, the Shield, the Critical Hit captive ball and the Hidden Temple. **LE** adds cosmetics only (mirrored backglass, shaker motor, upgraded audio, 740 numbered units).

name: Beetlejuice
description: Beetlejuice pinball rules: start the eight purple story modes, run Afterlife Couch Multiball, use SpookySpeak voice control, and reach Singing in the Stairwell.

body.text: Beetlejuice is Spooky Pinball's 2025 standard-width machine designed by Luke "Spooky Luke" Peters and Corwin "Bug" Emery, based on the 1988 Tim Burton film. It ships as a Collector's Edition (999 units) alongside a standard edition; the two differ only in trim (armor, glass, topper, dust cover), not in rules. The headline gimmick is **SpookySpeak** voice control — the first pinball machine with voice controls — but it lives on the optional topper and is never required to play; every voice action has an Action-Button equivalent. Documentation for this recent machine is still filling in: multiballs and modes are well understood, but playfield-multiplier math, end-of-ball bonus, and the top wizard mode remain unconfirmed.
Layout

Three flippers — two lower plus a full-size **upper-right flipper** that services the "Waiting Room" upper playfield. Reading roughly clockwise: **Left Orbit** (figure-8s to the upper flipper), **Left Ramp** with the physical **Dante's Inferno roulette wheel**, the **Spinner** (feeds pops/Juno Scoop), three **pop bumpers**, the upper-left **Juno Scoop**, the center **Polaroid Camera targets** and **Center (multiplier) Scoop** with 1-2-3-4-5 inserts, the motorized **Sandworm** guarded by an Attack-from-Mars-style **wall-target bank**, the dual-lift **Right Ramp** (up = couch lock, down = loopable), the **Handbook target**, the convertible **Right Orbit / Deadend vari-target** with a drop target, the **Beetlejuice captive-ball sculpt**, and the **Mystery (coffin) Scoop**. Up top sit the **Afterlife Couch** ball lock, the **Upper Loop** (Knock inserts), and the Waiting Room standups/scoop/orbit. A **Magna-Save magnet** between the lower flippers auto-rescues outlane and center drains, making the game unusually forgiving.
Skill shots

The **Standard Skill Shot** rewards releasing the plunge on a lit value and feeds the right flipper; a miss is auto-caught by the magnet without spending a save. The **Super Skill Shot** — the only chain the code scores as a true "combo" — asks you to immediately hit Left Ramp -> Right Ramp -> Spinner while lit.
Modes (the purple stack)

All eight Beetlejuice modes use one flow: shoot **purple-lit shots three times** to light Mode Start, cycle to your pick with the **Mode Change switch** and press Launch to lock it, then **shoot the Right Orbit** to start. Documented modes: As Seen on TV (7 easy shots then the captive ball), Grave Dig (scoops -> headstone -> ramps -> orbit), Day-O Dinner Party (timed; the machine takes the flippers; switch hits build a multiplier), Head Shrink, Charades, Beetle Snake (3 pops, 30 spins, 3 ramps), 'Til Death (blue shots; spinner raises multiplier, right ramp raises shot value), and Otho's Seance (start and finish at the Handbook target). Modes cannot be started during a multiball. The Juno/Waiting Room chain runs Take a Number (Juno Scoop) -> Advance Counter -> Now Serving.
Multiballs

items: **Afterlife Couch / Now Serving** (3-ball, easiest): loop the Upper Loop to light locks, lock 3 on the Right Ramp; green shots for jackpots, Knock loop builds value, re-lock for the Super at Spinner/Juno.
**Strange and Unusual** (2-ball): inlanes light the Camera targets, hit each to start, shoot ramps for jackpots, complete flashing sets to add a ball.

**It's Showtime**: spell S-H-O-W-T-I-M-E on yellow shots (only available when a mode is qualified but not started), start at the Right Orbit, then ricochet a locked ball off the Right Orbit Drop Target into the vari-target for the Strength Test Super Jackpot (first one adds a ball).
**Sandworm Battle**: bash the wall targets, lower the wall, shoot the mouth to deplete its health bar (battles include Gut Punch, Sharp Shooter, Walk With Rhythm).

body.text: Multipliers, toys, and awards

**Returning Souls** is the playfield multiplier: pops spawn Lost Souls, returned via lit shots to briefly raise the X shown on the Center Scoop's 1-5 inserts (values/duration TBD). A separate **bonus multiplier** is fed by the upper-right Waiting Room standups (exact mechanics unconfirmed). The **Dante's Inferno Wheel** (Left Ramp) awards Super Pops/Ramps/Spinner/Worm at 5x, Extra Ball, points, or "You Lose." The **Mystery/coffin scoop** grants Lite Lock, points, Advance Now Serving, Lite Ball Save, or the Shooting Gallery video mode. **Magna-Save** re-qualifies at the Handbook target.
Wizard

**Singing in the Stairwell** is the documented mini-wizard multiball, lit by completing 2 modes or starting 4; it has built-in add-a-balls and a Super Jackpot at the Juno Scoop collected with the Action Button. A top-tier wizard mode and the Scare-o-meter remain undocumented.
Strategy

The strong opener is the Super Skill Shot into 1-2 Wheel spins for guaranteed value, then the Upper Loop to light the easy Couch multiball, tapping upper standups for bonus X along the way. Big scores come from stacking a brief Returning Souls playfield X and a Wheel Super onto Afterlife Couch Super Jackpots via the Knock loop — not from any combo chain, as the game has no formal combo system.

name: The Evil Dead
description: The Evil Dead pinball rules: build the GROOVY and Blood Flood multipliers, run Cabin and Deadite Multiball, and unlock the Bonus Ball and wizard/token modes.

body.text: **The Evil Dead** is a boutique, single-trim widebody from Spooky Pinball — the **Collector's Edition**, limited to **888 units** (~$9,999). Because there is only one edition, **every machine is fully loaded**: every shot and mech below is present on all units (`trim = all`). Design by Corwin "Bug" Emery and "Spooky Luke" Peverill, art by Christopher Franchi, code by Ben Heck, with Bruce Campbell voice. It's Spooky's most mech-heavy game to date. Note: the ruleset is still evolving (code shipping through v2026.04.01), so exact combo timers and point values for some newer features aren't yet finalized.
The playfield

Two main flippers sit at the bottom. A **Hidden Sling Flipper** replaces the left slingshot (fired by the upper-left button) and reaches the left orbit, left ramp, left deadite, and drops. An **upper-right mini flipper** feeds a ramp/loop. Below the main field is an RGB-lit **fruit-cellar lower playfield** with its own flipper, loop, launch, and drain, reached by opening the **Cellar Door** (Action button).

Key shots: **left, middle (lift), and right ramps** (all backhandable; the right ramp has a **mode-start scoop** beneath it); **left/right/inner/rear orbits** and a hard-to-find **center super spinner**; the **six inline GROOVY drops**; the **cabin drops + Cabin VUK lock**; three **Necklace standups**; two pop-up **Deadites** (Evil Scotty left, Evil Ed right) guarding the ramps; the **Evil Ash Hand** bash toy; the **Necronomicon captive ball** (mode selector); the **rising Cheryl lift bank**; the **shotgun/boomstick shell targets**; and the **Deadite pop cluster** hosting the Blood Flood targets and the Good/Bad Linda head.
Skill shots

The **Standard Skill Shot** roves a lit insert onto the GROOVY targets — plunge to hit it for **1,000,000 + 500,000**, which also advances GROOVY. The **Super Skill Shot** holds the left flipper for a soft plunge; hit the random flashing shot within **5 seconds** (the only hard timer in the game) for **2x** value.
Scoring multipliers (build these first)

items: **GROOVY** — collect the six drops in order for a **20% boost to all scoring** for the rest of the ball, and light Mystery on the right orbit. The highest-leverage repeatable thing each ball.

**Dagger (Kandarian) shot multiplier** — inlanes light the **opposite orbit** to boost it; double-tap the upper flipper button and hit the **Launch button** for a 10-second build-up. Arm it *before* firing high-value shots.
**Blood Flood** — complete the three targets in the pop-bumper nest for a **playfield multiplier**. Stacking this under a multiball multiplies every jackpot.
**Inlanes** award extra points; same-color fill scores **x2**.

body.text: Combos and the Bonus Ball

A combo is consecutive lit shots inside a window; tighter chains pay a bigger **speed bonus** (as in Undying Love's ramp→ramp chain). The general-purpose combo runs on the **Necklace targets** in any mode not otherwise using them. Combos plus the shot multiplier qualify the **Bonus Ball** — a free timed extra ball at game's end focused on combos and ball locks, the skill-gated reward for clean shooters. The **left ramp** is the premier repeatable farm (Delta 88 wants 88 shots there).
Multiballs

items: **Cabin Multiball** — the easiest to qualify and the bread-and-butter stack. Drop the cabin targets and lock at the Cabin VUK; **lock state persists between balls/players and is stealable**. Designed to stack onto a running story mode.

**Double Deadite Multiball** — collect orange deadite arrows, both inlanes, and hit the popped deadites. **Stacks with all modes and multiballs**; knock down a deadite and collect the jackpot behind it, with **Deadite Frenzy** on the second pass.

**Double-Barrel Boomstick Multiball** — load shells, open the cellar (window ~15 seconds or 3 drains), hit **Lock and Load** in the basement, then fire on the Launch cue; purple shots = jackpots, reload shells to relight the action-button jackpot. High value, high drain risk.
**Cheryl / Henrietta Multiballs** — larger mode-driven MBs (two Movie-1 completions qualify Cheryl via the lift bank); both are restartable if missed.

body.text: Modes and wizard modes

Story modes qualify off the lit white ramps and start at the **scoop under the right ramp**; the **captive ball** selects which. The Movie-1 set (Evil Awakens, Hacked to Bits, It Won't Let Us Leave, Undying Love) is the natural entry point. **Wizard/token modes** — Kandarian Demon (the multi-phase marquee), Hail to the King (25 deadite hits → global multiplier), Destroy the Book, Hero From The Sky, Delta 88 — are gated by **Spooky Tokens**: hold the Action button while pressing Start to spend them, ideally with multipliers already up. A **Tournament Mode** disables the Hail to the King global multiplier by default.
Strategy in brief

It is a center-drain game — SDTM control and nudging are the primary survival skills, and the pop-up deadites and the Hand are the main source of dangerous rebounds, so hit them only with a controlled ball. **Best opener:** standard skill shot → lit ramp to qualify Mode 1 → bank cabin drops/lock (persistent, never wasted) → start a Movie-1 mode → build GROOVY/Blood Flood/Dagger, then stack Cabin MB and Deadite MB on top. Save the risky Boomstick basement run for when multipliers are up.

name: Aerosmith
description: Aerosmith pinball rules: pick a song mode, feed the Toy Box for Toys in the Attic Multiball, build Shot X and 2X Playfield, and reach Final Tour wizard mode.

body.text: Designer John Borg; code/rules Lonnie Ropp. Three editions: **Pro**, **Premium**, and **LE** (500 units, cosmetic-only vs Premium). Central toy is **Jacky** the jack-in-the-box on the **Toy Box** (an air-ball ball lock).
Core loop

Pick one of **nine song modes** at ball start via Jacky the Jukebox (timed, default 50s). Make a shot, then shoot the **left scoop** for **Crank It Up** to boost the mode and unlock its Super feature. Feed the **Toy Box** between mode shots to bank locks. Chip the nine **AEROSMITH standup targets** to qualify shot multipliers and Mystery.
Multiballs

items: **Toy Box Multiball ("Toys in the Attic"):** shoot Toy Box to light lock, shoot the lock saucer to lock. 3 locks start it (stack up to 6 for 2x base jackpots). Goal: all 8 major shots twice; 8th = Super Jackpot. Relock during MB for **1 ball = 20s of 2x / 2 balls = 3x** playfield scoring — the only multiball with a playfield multiplier, and the game's highest ceiling.

**Elevator Multiball ("Love in an Elevator"):** shoot both orbits (Premium/LE can also use the drop target) to light the elevator lock; 3 locks start it. Super Jackpot = % of all jackpots collected (100/75/50%). No playfield multiplier.

body.text: Multipliers

items: **Shot X (AEROSMITH targets):** spell A-E-R-O-S-M-I-T-H to qualify flashing "X" inserts; next major shot hit with an X scores 2x for the rest of the ball. Light every X on one ball → roving **3x**.
**Bonus X:** the three DUDE inlanes (cycle with flippers) raise end-of-ball bonus (max 9X–10X per code).
**2X Playfield (Premium/LE only):** backhand the five upper mini-playfield targets, then shoot the loop exit → 2x scoring for 60s. On Pro this exists only as a Mystery "Double Scoring" award.

**Combos:** the standard modern-Stern strobing-arrow system — after a major shot, the other arrows strobe; hitting one inside the window scores **2x** (and 2x coins in modes). Stacks multiplicatively with shot-X and playfield multipliers.

body.text: Money sequences

items: **Walk This Way** alternating ramp loop (left↔center ramp) is the biggest repeatable — best saved until the center/left ramp is X-loaded (and 2x playfield lit on Prem/LE).
**Toy Box Multiball** with a 3x window banked, farming the 8-shot jackpot ladder.

body.text: Wizard modes

items: **Medley Multiball** (mini-wizard): earn ≥1 award in all 9 songs (+ both multiballs); start at left scoop; replay unfinished songs. +10M per song completed beforehand.
**Final Tour** (grand wizard): complete all 9 songs; advance 24 Cities (8 shots each, 10M/20M/30M tiers); 100M Super Jackpot at the left scoop.

body.text: Skill shots

items: **Hidden:** soft plunge into the lock saucer → 500K (+500K per repeat) + 1 Smart Missile, and it progresses a lock.
**Super:** hold left flipper, short-plunge to the right flipper, shoot one of three lit shots → 1M (+1M per repeat) + 2 Smart Missiles.

body.text: Extra balls (all at the left eject/scoop)
Start 3 song modes; collect 5 (+variable) Dead Shot Jackys; or percentage-based Mystery. **VIP Pass** ball save lights at the right outlane by completing the two Toy Box-flanking targets.

name: Black Knight: Sword of Rage
description: Black Knight: Sword of Rage pinball rules: win the five Monster Battles, charge the Sword of Rage power meter, run KNIGHT Multiball, and reach Black Castle.

body.text: Designer Steve Ritchie, code Tim Sexton, art Kevin O'Connor/Zombie Yeti. Spike 2 hardware in **Pro / Premium / LE** editions. Premium/LE add a transparent upper playfield with a 3rd (right) flipper and the **Catapult** ball-launcher, enabling Catapult Multiball and Last Chance; the Pro is a lower-playfield-only game. The central toy is a motorized **Black Knight** with a spinning **flail** on one face and a raise/lower **shield** hiding the **shield scoop/VUK** behind it. Reputation: brutally punishing because shot guides are bouncy rubber posts close to the flippers — hence the mantra **"backhand, backhand, backhand"** (orbits are the safe exception).
Skill Shots

items: **Pro Standard:** plunge into the lit W-A-R top lane (750K, +250K each).
**Pro Super:** hold left flipper, hit a center shot (1.5M, +500K each).
**Prem/LE Standard:** hit the light-lock target under the Catapult (1M).
**Prem/LE Super:** full plunge to lock in the upper Catapult (2M).

body.text: Monster Battles (the modes)

Five color-coded battles — **Mud Bog** (Hydra), **Molten Fire** (Magma Beast), **Burning Sands** (Sandworm), **Wicked Cavern** (Hell Hand), **Deep Freeze** (Lich Lords). Hit the three center shots to light a battle (the monster is set by the lightning wheel), shoot the flail ramp to raise the shield, then shoot the shield scoop to start. Battles carry ball-to-ball on a ~65s timer; win one for a KNIGHT letter and a lit Extra Ball. Win all five to qualify the **Black Castle** wizard mode.
Sword of Rage / "The Power"

Charge the meter with right 3-bank drop hits (bank completion ≈ +20%, individual ≈ +1%). When full, POWER lights at the center target — collect it during a battle for **2x scoring the whole battle** plus that mode's power upgrade.
Multiballs

items: **Triple Knights Challenge (all):** hit the light-lock shield standup to light locks, lock 3 at the scoop, then jackpot phases culminating in a Super Jackpot worth 3x + a KNIGHT letter.
**Catapult Multiball (premium-le):** lock 3 in the upper Catapult; lower shots pay 250K jackpots, Super Jackpot at the Catapult with a multiplier up to 4x.

**KNIGHT Multiball (all):** spell K-N-I-G-H-T (from battles, WAR hurry-ups, Triple Knights super jackpots), start at the left spinner lane. Retro 3-ball MB with playfield scoring x balls-in-play (up to 3x) — the game's biggest scoring window.
**The King's Ransom (2nd KNIGHT):** ~60s 3-ball MB, unlimited ball save, +5x Bonus X, Extra Ball lit.
**RAGE Multiball:** the final phase of Black Castle — a 6-ball frenzy with the center target lit for 1M+/hit.

body.text: Combos & money

BKSOR has **no conventional combo system**: the only true combo is the **U-Turn** (orbit→orbit loop that lights an Extra Ball at the shield scoop). Real points come from farming **Super Features** (esp. the Super Spinner — light SUPER at the center target via the spinner, boost at the left lane until purple) and cashing them via a **Magna-Save Super Jackpot** inside the 3x KNIGHT Multiball, using Triple Knights as the base MB and always stacking a mode. **WAR hurry-ups** (complete the W-A-R top lanes) are repeatable and escalate.
Awards & defense

**Mystery** (complete R-A-G-E inlane/outlane rollovers) lights the scoop for a random award. **Magna-Save** (action button) catches the ball at the right outlane and cashes any active Supers as a Super Jackpot — relight it by completing the right drops. **Bonus X** advances via WAR-lane completions.
Wizard — Black Castle → RAGE Multiball

Win all five battles, start at the scoop (~200s): hit the three inner shots to light four outer loops, complete the loops, then a final shield-scoop shot delivers the killing blow and starts 6-ball RAGE Multiball. After it resolves the five battles reopen — the repeatable capstone.
*Edition tags:* Catapult MB, upper-playfield shots/3rd flipper, Last Chance, and Prem/LE skill shots are `premium-le`; everything else is `all`.

name: Guardians of the Galaxy
description: Guardians of the Galaxy pinball rules: complete all eight character modes, run Groot and Orb Multiball, and battle through to Save Xandar wizard mode.

body.text: **Designer John Borg, SPIKE-2 hardware. Pro / Premium / LE — identical rule flow; edition differences are cosmetic/mech (motorized Orb reveal, sculpted Groot arms, extra magnets, LE shaker/mirror).**

**The arc:** play and complete the **8 character modes** and **both primary multiballs** (Groot, Orb), which gate the wizard modes: **Cherry Bomb** (4 modes) → **Immolation Initiative** (≥50% on all 8 modes + both MBs) → **Save Xandar** (all 8 modes + both MBs).
Modes (started/selected at the right scoop, or pre-picked with flippers)

Antiquities Shop, Knowhere, Escape Kyln, Pod Chase, Quill's Quest, Sanctuary, Sibling Rivalry, Yaka Arrow. Shoot flashing shots; the mode **timer never stops** (cancel animations with both flippers). Completing a mode adds ~10% of its total to end-of-ball bonus for the rest of the game and turns its shot into a **5x jackpot** in Groot MB. Sanctuary alone restarts from scratch on timeout.
Multiballs

items: **Groot MB:** open the jaw (2 flanking standups), lock 3 balls (4+ after) in the mouth; jackpots start 300k +25k, Super at 9th/18th. Re-lock during MB = 2x/3x playfield.

**Orb MB:** drop the Orb target + hit standup behind = 1 Orb; collect 3. Hurry-up value (from 2M) locks the jackpot value; shooting the Orb doubles the next jackpot. **The high-score engine** — but the Orb Super Jackpot must be physically shot (Hadron blocked).

body.text: Multipliers (all multiply each other)

items: **Rocket's Rampage:** spell RAMPAGE at Rocket (RAMP spotted free → 3 shots) = 2x playfield 45s, +10s per further Rocket shot (additive).
**Nova Corps:** complete 5 red rollovers (top lanes + inlanes), lock 2x on a chosen shot for the ball; roving 3x after.
**Combo:** flowed shot-to-shot = 2x that shot.

body.text: Support systems

items: **Hadron Enforcer** (action button): 5 yellow standups → 3 charges that spot the left-most lit shot. Can't make Sanctuary/Escape-Kyln-Rocket/Orb-drop-free or any final Super.
**GUARDIANS target:** spots letters + advances bonus multiplier; spelling it lights scoop Mystery.
**Ball save:** the two Groot standups light a virtual right-outlane kickback.
**Skill shots:** standard (top lane 250k), hands-free (2x), super (hold left flipper, full plunge, hit white shot 1M).
**Extra balls:** at 3 modes started, then 6 modes completed.

body.text: **Strategy consensus:** make **modes, not multiball, the priority** — they drive extra balls, Cherry Bomb, bonus carryover, and 5x Groot jackpots. Stack Rampage 2x + Nova 2x onto a big Super for 600M–1.8B.

name: Deadpool
description: Deadpool pinball rules: win the three Battles vs Juggernaut, Mystique and Sabretooth, stack Playfield X, run all six multiballs, and reach The Final Battle.

body.text: **Designer:** George Gomez. A two-flipper Marvel game built around **Battles**, **Quests**, six **Multiballs**, and a deep combo/weapon economy. Rules are essentially identical across Pro/Premium/LE; the only rules-affecting edition difference is the Premium/LE **Disco Loops** variant of Disco Multiball.
Core loops

items: **Battles (start at the Scoop):** Juggernaut, Mystique, Sabretooth. Complete **D-E-A-D** standups to light a Battle, taunt/damage via flashing shots, then **finish at the Scoop within 10s** (Final Shot ≈ remaining health, up to ~30M). Sabretooth is easiest (orbits + Wolverine spinner + pops); Juggernaut is most valuable but needs the risky side targets.
**Quests:** T-Rex (advance the chimichanga truck via Right Orbit, throw 5 bombs at the Lil' Deadpool target) then Megalodon (hit the roving red shot 5×). Both collect a Mode Jackpot at the Scoop.

**Team-Ups (X-Force):** hit a Team-Up shot twice to recruit, then re-hit it during a Battle to trigger — Dazzler (left orbit, +health/time), Colossus (U-Turn, 2× points), Wolverine (center spinner, 2× damage), Domino (right orbit, boosts villain feature).

body.text: Multiballs (six)

items: **Lil' Deadpool MB** — drop the OOF 3-bank, hit the Lil' Deadpool standup 2×, lock a ball. Cheap "stacking fuel."
**Ninja MB** — lock 3 balls at the Katana ramp (relight locks via P-O-O-L). Jackpots scale with collected **Ninja Stars**, so players hoard stars and delay it.
**Disco MB** — ~60–70 spins of the left (Dazzler) spinner; starts only when no other mode runs. (Premium/LE: odd thresholds give **Disco Loops** instead.)
**Mechsuit MB** — cash out 45 weapons, start at the Scoop.
**Sauron MB** (mini-wizard) — win all 3 Level-1 Battles; unlocks Level-2 Battles.
**Clone MB** (mini-wizard #2) — win all 3 Level-2 Battles.

body.text: Weapons, Ninja Stars, Chimichangas, BOOM

items: **Weapons:** shoot white combo shots, then the **Scoop** to cash out (value scales with shots before the scoop). 25→Extra Ball, 45/150/250→Mechsuit MB, every 100→permanent +1 Playfield X.
**Ninja Stars:** pop-bumper hits light shots blue; collect them to inflate Ninja MB jackpots. **Ninjapocalypse** (Right Orbit → Katana ramp) dumps ~10 stars at once.
**BOOM button:** spell BOOM at the return/inlanes; flashing button spots the highest lit shot. Complete BOOM 4× without using it for "Big Boom" (all lit shots).

body.text: Multipliers

items: **Playfield X (1x→5x):** temporary via **SNIKT standup → Katana ramp** ricochet; permanent +1x per 100 weapons; +1x for the ball from Lil' Deadpool Bounce. Higher temp X times out faster — spike it right before a scoring window.
**Bonus Multiplier:** raised by completing the top **BAM!** lanes (resets per ball).

body.text: Skill shots (4 tiers)
Lane (BAM lane, 2.5M+), Super (hold left flipper → Katana ramp, 5M+), MXV (right orbit → ramp combo, 12.5M+), Super Secret (SNIKT → ramp, 15M + 1 Playfield X).
Wizard path

Two tracks converge: **Quests + Sauron MB → Megakrakolodonus Rex** (mini-wizard #1) and **Level-2 Battles → Clone MB** (mini-wizard #2). Completing both mini-wizards **plus** Mechsuit MB lights **The Final Battle (Mr. Sinister)** — the game's wizard mode.

name: Jurassic Park
description: Jurassic Park pinball rules: rescue and capture dinosaurs across four paddocks, run Raptor Tri-Ball Multiball, and reach the Escape Nublar wizard mode.

body.text: **Editions:** Pro, Premium, LE (plus 30th Anniversary, Home). Identical software rules; Premium/LE add a **motorized animatronic T-Rex** at the left ramp (catches/throws the ball) and a **captive-ball raptor pen** with a physical lock. Pro uses a hold-post and virtual locks. Trim `premium-le` marks the two edition-specific mechs; everything else is `all`.
The core loop: MAP → Paddock → Rescue → Capture

Spell **M-A-P** with white-arrow shots (1 arrow for Paddock 1, 3 for each later paddock), then shoot the **Left Ramp** to advance. Each paddock is a two-phase "traffic light": **Rescue** (hit red rescue shots before the drifting green dino reaches them) then **Capture** (Set-Trap targets by the truck light yellow/green). Capturing a dino grants a permanent perk. **Super Predators** (Dilophosaurus 1.5, T-Rex 2.5, Spinosaurus 3.5) each add **+1× Bonus X**. After Paddock 4, spelling MAP again lights **Visitor's Center**.
Multiballs

items: **Chaos MB (3-ball):** spell C-H-A-O-S at Control Room ("C") → Left Ramp (H) → Right Ramp (A) → Right Orbit (O) → Helipad (S), then start at the lit Amber/pops target. Truck direction picks the lit jackpot half.

**Raptor Tri-Ball (3→6 ball):** the most valuable MB. Chip the Raptor Pen standups to light it, drop Fence Integrity to 0%, shoot the dead-end lane. Phases: ramp jackpots → CHAOS jackpots → +3 balls Super CHAOS (Right Ramp 2×, Upper Loop 3× × balls in play) → Rampage.
**Feed T-Rex (2-ball):** spell T-REX at the truck, build the Left Ramp hurry-up with orange arrows, collect at the Left Ramp to start (no ball save until it starts).
**King of the Island (3-ball):** auto-lit at the Left Ramp after capturing the Spinosaurus at paddock 3.5.

body.text: Modes

items: **Control Room** (single-ball, pick 1 of 3): **Virus Attack**, **Restore Power** (rip Spinner), **System Boot** (combo-based, tournament favorite). All three → **Secure Control Room**.

**T-Rex Events** (spell T-REX): Feed → Chase → Encounter → **Rampage** (the top money farm: Left/Right Ramp lowers T-Rex, Helipad 2× + Raptor Tower 3× loaders stack to 6×, collect at Left Ramp for 10M +5M/shot). All four → **Museum Mayhem**.
**Pteranodon Attack:** 4 Right-Ramp shots qualify a switch frenzy collected at the Right Ramp.

body.text: Combos (no combo timer — the defining quirk)

**11 DNA combos** (fixed sequences, ~1-2M base): 6 → Extra Ball, 11 → Fossil. Easiest: Triceratops (Left Ramp → Amber), Ankylosaurus (Helipad → Control Room). The **6-Way Combo** (Spinner, Upper Loop, Tower, Helipad, Left Ramp, Right Ramp in any order) scales ×1→×40 and awards a Fossil. **Upper Loop → Tower Ramp** scores 3× and counts as 2 tower shots.
Multipliers

items: **Playfield 2×** (45s): collect a Supply Drop to light the Nedry 2× standup, shoot it. Cash during jackpot-heavy multiballs.
**Bonus X** (end-of-ball, carries across balls): +1× per Super Predator and at rescue thresholds 13/22.

body.text: Wizard modes

Four mini-wizards (Visitor's Center, Museum Mayhem, Secure Control Room, plus hidden Invalid Frenzy). Completing the first three → main wizard **Escape Nublar** (single-ball, tilt = instant loss, 125M-550M island bonus). Escape Nublar + the three mini-wizards → ultra wizard **When Dinosaurs Ruled the Earth** (6-ball, 60s, unlimited ball save), after which the game ends.
Meta: Fossils
11 fossils in 4 sets fuel end-of-ball bonus and progress. Set completions grant big points, Extra Balls, and one-time 10× Amber/Pteranodon boosts; all 11 = 500M.

name: The Mandalorian
description: The Mandalorian pinball rules: complete Missions and Encounters, run the three Razor Crest multiballs, stack the Fire Triangle, and reach This Is The Way.

body.text: Designer **Brian Eddy**, Stern SPIKE 2. Editions: **Pro / Premium / LE**. The game is built on the "3 M's" — **Modes** (Missions + Encounters), **Multiballs** (Razor Crest), and **Multipliers** — feeding three mini-wizard modes and the **This Is The Way** wizard mode.
Skill Shots

items: **Regular Skill Shot:** plunged ball feeds the CHILD top lanes; a firm plunge hits the "C" lane. Award **1,000,000**, +1M cumulatively each later skill shot, plus a rotating award (+2 Bonus X / Light The Child / +1 Super Pops).

**Super Skill Shot:** hold left flipper past the C lane to arm **U-Turn → right ramp → one final shot** (~5s each). Final shot picks the reward — **left scoop** starts the lit Mission, **left ramp** the lit Encounter, **center ramp** Razor Crest MB/Hurry-Up.

body.text: Multiballs — Razor Crest (3 versions)

Qualify by hitting the center **Razor Crest** uplift target (~3 hits first time, more each subsequent MB); the **Boba/Fett** targets cycle which is next: **(1) Ice Spider, (2) Jetpack, (3) Pirates**. Start at the **center ramp**. Super Jackpots add **+2.5M each to end-of-ball bonus**. After a MB, complete **Hunter** to relight the center target for a **Razor Crest Hurry-Up**. **Ambush** is a separate value-building multiball/hurry-up (trigger: U-Turn on Pro / right scoop on Prem-LE), cashed at the right ramp (~720M ceiling with all multipliers).
Modes

items: **Missions (5):** Find the Asset, Deceive the Magistrate, Destroy the Imperial Base, Defeat the Mudhorn, Infiltrate the Freighter. Light by shooting **both ramps**, start at **left scoop**. 60s timer; completion = 2.5M bonus + 225K × seconds left. Starting 2 lights the Extra Ball. All 5 qualifies **I Like Those Odds**.
**Encounters (3):** qualify via **left ramp** (1 shot first, +2 each after); fought on the Encounter mini-playfield (Prem/LE = 2 tilting flippers, Pro = 1). All 3 qualifies **You Have What I Want**.
**Hunter:** complete the left standup bank → Hunter lights on an inlane → shoot flashing orbit then opposite orbit. ≥250 Beskar + Orange multiplier.
**Scope:** hit three blue arrows (U-Turn, left 2X target, right ramp) → collect at left inlane. Blue multiplier.

body.text: Multipliers

Three **+1X playfield** inserts: **Boba Fett → Green (30s)**, **Hunter → Orange (75s)**, **Scope → Blue (75s)**. All three = **+5X for 6X total**. **Flamethrower** adds a one-shot **2X** on flaming arrows (stacks → ~12X). This is the **"Fire Triangle"** high-score play. **Bonus X** grows +1x per CHILD completion and +2x per skill shot. Completing This Is The Way grants a permanent **+1x Signet**.
Wizard Path

Complete all three mini-wizards (**Precious Cargo**, **You Have What I Want**, **I Like Those Odds**), then make all six major lit shots + left scoop to start **This Is The Way** (10M + Signet; resets Missions/MBs/Encounters).
Economy

**Beskar** currency funds the **Foundry** (lit at left scoop): buy two adjacent items per visit; each purchase raises that item's cost +50%. Notable: Extra Ball 600, Multiplier 500, Flamethrower 175. The **Child/Grogu** mystery award (via orbits) grants Beskar, equipment, multipliers, and Light Extra Ball.
