*Editions differ mainly on the Encounter mini-playfield (rotating dual-flipper on Prem/LE vs single-flipper on Pro), the Grogu Force magnet (Prem/LE only), the up/down inner-loop scoop ramp (Prem/LE), and the Ambush trigger (U-Turn Pro / right scoop Prem-LE).*

name: Rush
description: Rush pinball rules: collect 100 Years at the Time Machine, win all six multiballs and six song modes, and reach the 2112 grand wizard mode's final battle.

body.text: **Designer:** John Borg. Theme: travel through Rush's music history in a "Time Machine." Three editions (Pro / Premium / LE) share one rule flow; the only genuine rules-level edition difference is the Premium/LE **Freewill 20-second captive-ball hold** jackpot-booster. Other differences are physical toys (motorized ramp diverter, motorized Clockwork Angels clock, Far Cry subway lock, Dead End vertical up-kicker, three-bank musical drops).
The Big Goal
Collect **100 Years**, complete both **Cygnus X-1** mini-wizard books, and reach the final wizard mode **2112**.
Time Machine & Years (core hub)

The center **Time Machine** ramp is the hub. Every **10 Years** upgrades it (rest-of-ball perks, easier RUSH targets, Light Extra Ball at 2062, +balls/ball-save for multiballs, 2x ramp count-up, and 2112 unlocked at 100). Each upgrade also reduces the shots needed to start the next Time Machine multiball by 1. Years come from completing modes (+5, or +10 if the mode scored 80M+), multiball super jackpots, combos (+1 each), the 6x Instrument Bonus (+5), and Bastille Day.
Skill Shots

Soft-plunge to the upper flipper — **NEVER full plunge** (bumpers are deadly). Lit target: **side loop = 1x, side ramp = 2x, side scoop = 3x**. **Super Skill Shot** = side loop then combo into side ramp OR side scoop = 2x value + double ball-save. Every skill shot adds ball-save time.
The Six Multiballs

items: **Three Time Machine MBs** — Red Barchetta, Subdivisions, Fly By Night. Power up the Time Machine ramp (base 6 shots, −1 per decade), then one more to start; shoot **Dead End** to change which one is lit.

**Far Cry MB** — hit the two green **LIGHT LOCK** targets by the right ramp, shoot the **right ramp** to light lock, lock 2 balls (subway on Premium/LE, virtual on Pro). Collect 15 colored jackpots (blue 1x → red 5x) then Time Machine for the Super. Super triggers **One Little Victory** (6-ball victory laps).
**Headlong Flight MB** — advance the **Clockwork Angels drum clock** to midnight via **pop bumpers**, start at the **right orbit**. The ONLY multiball that stacks with others.
**Freewill MB** — collect all 3 instruments (bass/guitar/drums) on the drop bank, activate, then shoot the instrument lane.

body.text: The Six Song ("Planet") Modes (untimed)

Collect flashing colored records, then shoot the Time Machine (red-lit) to start; the color you have most of picks the song. **Tom Sawyer** (cyan), **Working Man** (orange), **The Spirit of Radio** (blue), **The Big Money** (pink), **La Villa Strangiato** (purple, 12-shot combo), **Limelight** (green). Completing a mode = +5 Years and a **Rainbow Record**. All six done lights Cygnus X-1 Book 2.
1-2-3 Combos & the 10 Albums

Shoot the flashing **1 → 2 → 3** inserts in order to light the **Combo Jackpot** at the Time Machine, then the **Side Ramp** for the **Combo Super Jackpot (2x)**. Farm the **Side Loop** during the Super (500K + 100K/shot up to 1M, x shot multipliers). Each unique 1-2-3 sequence awards one of 10 albums; matching an album to the active mode/MB arms **The Weapon** (spot all shots, or add-a-ball). Hemispheres (Right Ramp → Right Orbit) is the only 2-shot album and is farmed as a reserve Weapon.
Multipliers

items: **Rainbow Records** — completing any mode lets you place a permanent **2x shot multiplier**; stack them on safe inner shots (inner loop, dead-end, spinner, right ramp). They vanish on drain.
**Bonus X** — spinner-driven, up to 25x (doubled with Guitar active).

body.text: Wizard Modes

items: **Cygnus X-1 Book 1 "The Voyage"** — start all 6 multiballs.
**Cygnus X-1 Book 2 "Hemispheres"** — complete all 6 song modes.
**2112** — 100 Years + both Cygnus books; ~15-min finale with a 6-ball Overture and six phases.

body.text: Strategy Doctrine

Complete modes without draining so Rainbow-Record multipliers stack; prioritize **Far Cry MB** and keep **Headlong Flight** stacked on everything; soft-plunge every ball; light outlane ball-saves early via RUSH targets.

name: James Bond 007
description: James Bond 007 pinball rules: complete Villain and Henchmen modes, run Jetpack and Bird One Multiball, and reach On Her Majesty's Secret Service wizard mode.

body.text: Designer George Gomez; code by Lonnie Ropp & Mike Vinikour. 1960s Connery era. Editions: **Pro / Premium / LE** share the exact same shot geometry; only mechanical toys differ (`premium-le`: motorized Bird One rocket + physical Swipe-A-Ball lock, magnetic Jetpack that carries the ball over the Dragon Tank). The **007 60th Anniversary (2023)** is a separate machine and is NOT covered here.
Structure

The game is a mode game: **4 categories × 6 modes** (one per Connery film) = **Villain modes** (start at the **right ramp**), **Henchmen modes** (start at the **side ramp** off the upper flipper), **SPECTRE Weapons** (spell SPECTRE at the **rocket lane**, start at the flashing **Goldfinger target**), and **Q Branch modes** (lit by feature progress). Completing a whole category lights that category's **mini-wizard**; collecting all four mini-wizards + the "Bond… James Bond" multiball leads to the final wizard **On Her Majesty's Secret Service**.
Multiballs

items: **Jetpack Multiball (2-ball)** — the beginner workhorse. Left eject lights the left ramp; left ramp starts it. Shoot the center lane fast to bank the hurry-up (~3M), make 5 jackpots, left ramp lights the double, then super + add-a-ball.

**Bird One Multiball** — the big numbers. Complete the Osato drop targets to light the lock, shoot the center loop 3× to lock, collect green single→double→triple jackpots, then hit the rocket for a super jackpot capped ~300M. Spell SPECTRE first to pump the base (1M + 25k/SPECTRE target).
**Q Branch 2-ball multiballs** — Attaché Case, DB5, Power Pack, Little Nellie convert to dedicated 2-ball multiballs on completion.

body.text: Scoring engine — 007 Scoring (Bond Women)

Qualify six Bond Women by feature progress (25 bumper hits, 3 right-orbit, 4 DB5 ejects, 4 left ejects, 10 rocket hits, 200 spinner spins), **collect at the upper loop**, then press the pink action button with 2+ collected to run a timed playfield multiplier: **2x/20s up to 7x/70s** (7x also grants a 30s ball save). Draining while the button flashes loses the multiplier and all collected Women. **Bonus multiplier** (end-of-ball, 1x→5x) advances by completing the **MI6 top lanes**.
Combos & smart missiles

20 named film/character combos (2M + 125k per unique combo/ball) plus the **Martini shot** (brick the side ramp → falls to the right ramp = smart missile + 1M). Both ramps feed the opposite flipper, so **Dr. No** (L→R ramp) and **Professor Dent** (R→L ramp) are the reliable starter combos. Smart missiles (max 4) auto-collect the hardest lit shot; earned from skill shots and every mode completion.
Recommended play

Plunge for **Licensed To Kill** (left eject — banks a missile AND lights Jetpack), start a villain mode off the **right ramp ×2**, start **Jetpack** at the left ramp, build Bond Women for the multiplier, and cash 007 Scoring during your biggest multiball. Avoid the **Dragon Tank** unless a multiball is running — it and the adjacent center loop are the main center-drain hazard.

name: Foo Fighters
description: Foo Fighters pinball rules: pick a Van Mode, build the Combotron combo system, run the Overlord multiball trilogy, and fight through The Final Battle.

body.text: **Theme:** The Foo Fighters road-trip across the country in the Tour Van, battling the alien **Overlord** and its bots, culminating in **The Final Battle**. Designer Jack Danger. Editions: **Pro / Premium / LE** (Premium & LE share rules; their key difference from Pro is an **Area 51 upper mini-playfield** and a physical **Deadpost** outlane save).
Core loops

items: **Van Modes (city/song modes):** Spell **V-A-N** with three lit white-arrow shots to light the **left ramp (Pat)**, then shoot it to hold the ball in the **Tour Van** and select a city. Six song modes — *Seattle "This Is A Call", Roswell "Run", Los Angeles "Learn to Fly", New Orleans "I'll Stick Around", Chicago "Something From Nothing", New York "Breakout"*. **The final shot of every mode is always the Overlord.** Buff modes first via **Van Mods** (drop targets → Mod-ulator paddle: Engine=time, Speakers=value, Bomb=spotted shots).

**Combos / band members:** Every major shot carries a **Combotron** insert; chaining lit shots builds combo value. Six named **band-member combos** (Taylor, Dave, Nate, Chris, Pat, Rami). Combos don't auto-score — you **cash out at the Overlord** (3× on a normal hit, 5× backhanding the back targets). Six cash-outs light the **side ramp (Taylor)** for **Combotron Multiball**.

**Multiballs:** **Overlord trilogy** (All My Life → Monkey Wrench → The Pretender, played in order, jackpots carry across); **Area 51 MB** (5 right-ramp (Dave) shots to qualify); **Combotron MB**; plus mini-wizard multiballs **FooBot** and **Toy Time**.

body.text: Multipliers (stack multiplicatively)

items: **Playfield 2×/3×** via the **Rock-O-Meter** — 3 right-orbit (Chris) shots fill it for 2× (40 s); refill while running for 3×.
**Ray Gun shot multiplier** — hit a return-lane Ray Gun target → next shot 2×; opposite target → 4×.
**FooBot part multipliers** — each collected part = permanent 2× at that band member's shot.
**Bonus X** at the paddle target, end-of-ball.

body.text: FooBot & wizards

Collect all **6 FooBot parts** (one per band member, each from a distinct feature) to light the left ramp for **FooBot Multiball**. **The Final Battle** (full wizard) requires all 14 van modes + Austin + D.C., all 3 Overlord multiballs, and FooBot MB — a 4-phase battle with ~1-minute unlimited ball saves per phase.
Tournament line

Build the Overlord early (it's the most drain-prone area — backhand the captive ball), mod the van (Engine for time), start **New Orleans** (all shots lit, side-flipper shots count twice), then stack **2× playfield + van mode + Overlord MB + Area 51** together for the money game. Bot Frenzy 8× spinner and Ray-Gun 4× layer onto the biggest shots.
Newer Stern code may shift exact numbers slightly; structures are stable.

name: Venom
description: Venom pinball rules: pick your host, fill the Grid through mini-modes, run Mayhem and Carnage Multiball, and battle through to Klyntar Multiball wizard mode.

body.text: **Designer:** Brian Eddy (layout) · **Code:** Dwight Sullivan & Raymond Davidson · **System:** SPIKE 2 · **Editions:** Pro / Premium / LE. You *are* Venom; Carnage is the arch-villain trying to return Knull to power. Up to 4 players, up to 7 multiballs, 2 flippers, 2 ramps (3 on Prem/LE).
Host Selection (the key early decision)

Pick a host with the **left flipper** at ball start (or mid-ball at the lit left ramp). Each host changes starting locks, skill shots, the signature combo, ball-save length, and emphasized rules. **Eddie Brock** is the consensus opener (2 locks pre-lit, Mayhem scores higher). **Flash Thompson** unlocks Sleeper immediately, collects the Bell Tower at the left loop, and has a battle-safe scoring combo. Gwen (2X Infected, better Doppelganger) and Peter (unlocks Miles, richer Carnage) are progression picks. Defeating Knull unlocks Venomized Hulk/Cap/Wolverine (each needs **two** Grid columns).
Progression: Mini-Modes → Grid → Battles

Three color-coded mini-modes always run; each is a **2-shot combo** (solid arrow, then the blinking timed one). Completing a mini-mode fills a Grid light **and** lights a Mayhem lock. Completing a full Grid column lights "change host" and, at **level 10+**, that host's **Battle** at the center ramp. Grid 2x2 blocks grant held perks (Extra Time, 2X Web Combos, +1X base playfield, Flame Thrower, 2X XP, Extra Ball Save).
Multiballs

items: **Mayhem** — mini-modes light locks; lock 2–6 balls in the twin symbiote vessels (hold the action button after lock 2 to keep stacking). Lock side picks your boss/perks (right-3 = +1X playfield). Jackpot flow: Quick → Main → Super (a Super defeats a Minor Boss).
**Carnage** — bash the captive ball into Ravencroft, start at the lit center ramp; escalates Carnage MB → Carnage Hurry-Up → Blood Lust. Stackable on Mayhem.
**Quick Doppelganger** (Prem/LE, Gwen/Wolverine) — right-loop post lock.

body.text: Battles

Minor Bosses **Riot / Agony / Phage / Lasher** (level 10+) → **Grendel** (level 20+) → **Knull** (level 30+). Web-combo shot multiplier doubles as damage multiplier; hit the Bell Tower to add phase time. Defeating Knull unlocks a Venomized host and resets XP.
Multipliers

items: **Playfield (1X→7X):** loop the center ramp (2, then 3, 4…) to light the Bell Tower target; hit it lit for +1X. **Cash X before firing big combos/hurry-ups.** Base boosts from the bottom-left Grid box, right-3 Mayhem lock, and Hybrid (instant 7X).
**Bell Tower Frenzy:** 4+ center ramps in a row before hitting the target.
**Shot Multiplier:** web combos, up to 5X at a 10-way combo.
**Bonus X (end-of-ball):** top lanes, Infected defeated, skill shots (+2/+4), Mystery.

body.text: Money Sequences (what point players farm)

items: **Center ramp → Bell Tower** to ratchet playfield to 7X.

**Host Hurry-Up** — play Toxin, complete your host's signature 4-way combo, then re-shoot those 4 shots at the scoop as a cascading hurry-up (500M–600M clean; billions under 7X). Flash's combo is best because it avoids the center ramp.
**Web combo to 5X**, then dump shots in Rampage/Blood Lust/Toxin.
**Toxin Team-Up** escalating jackpots (boost with the Carnage captive ball).
**The full stack:** 6-ball Mayhem + stacked Carnage + Host Hurry-Up, all under 7X.

body.text: Wizard Modes

items: **Toxin Team-Up** (mini) — Mayhem + Carnage + a Doppelganger defeated.
**Rampage** (medium) — 3 Doppelgangers defeated.
**Klyntar Multiball** (final) — defeat Knull and complete 8 objectives, then start at the center ramp.

body.text: Edition Notes (`premium-le`)

Physical Doppelganger flyaway targets, Quick Doppelganger MB, Million-Plus-Pops, the 3rd ramp/diverter, the raised Bell Tower mech, the Sneaky Hideout drop, and Symbiote Mania playfield morphing are Premium/LE. On Pro, Doppelganger is fought virtually at the left loop and its scoring **is** web-combo-multiplied. All combos, Host Hurry-Up, and the Bell Tower multiplier are code-identical across editions.
Note: there is no "flame ramp" combo award — the Bell Tower is a target, not a ramp.

name: The Uncanny X-Men
description: The Uncanny X-Men pinball rules: train in the Danger Room, complete all eight missions, run four multiballs, and reach Save Senator Kelly, the mini-wizard mode.

body.text: **Designer:** Jack Danger. **Editions:** Pro / Premium / LE (811 units). Code is young (~0.98) and being overhauled, so exact values drift.
Layout

Six primary "city" shots left→right: **X-Jet orbit, Downtown, Uptown ramp, Midtown center ramp, Subway, Highway ramp**. The signature **Danger Room** mini-playfield sits lower-left (mini-flipper, spinner, 3 standups, feed ramp, exit ramp) where a left outlane would be. Center **Sentinel head** (bash + lowering-mouth scoop + front magnet); Prem/LE add a rising Sentinel body with attacking hands. The **Cerebro** post above the left flipper handles virtual ball locks.
Core scoring engine — Danger Room Training

Feed the X-Jet orbit (or the spinner/targets/ramp) to fill the training bar. Lvl 1 (green) = next mission 2x; Lvl 2 (yellow) = -1 Sentinel in The Future; Lvl 3 (red) = Future Sentinels count double + values 2x; Lvl 4 = Cyclops perk (wider combo timers). Bank levels before every mission and multiball — they reset after a mission but multiball-jackpot inflation persists.
Missions (8, selectable)

Four easy "corner" Tier-1 missions (Rescue the Innocent, Bitter Rivalry, Smuggled Cargo, Stopping a Juggernaut) and four hard Tier-2 (Sentinel Facility Raid, A Fiery Assault, Mayhem in Midtown, Genosha Under Siege). Qualify by hitting white shots, then start at the blue strobing Midtown center ramp or Subway loop. Easy completion → **The Future**; hard completion → **Escape Nimrod**; both grant persistent hero perks. Complete 3 and 7 missions for extra balls.
Four multiballs

items: **Sentinel Multiball** — bash the Sentinel head (~3 hits +2 each subsequent) to open its mouth, then defeat it to start; top scoring MB (100-200M+).
**Save the City Multiball** — hit all six primary shots 3x in single-ball play, start at lit Midtown/Subway.
**To Me, My X-Men Multiball** — light Cerebro (Nightcrawler purple targets 5x or a Cerebro skill shot), then advance it 3x at Uptown/Highway ramps.
**Berzerker Multiball** — defeat 35 Sentinels cumulatively across modes, then start at the Uptown ramp.

body.text: Combos & money loops

Lit "X" shots chain for combos (200k → +200k → cap 1M; lit shots alternate to prevent farming one ramp). 6 combos light **Sentinel Attack** hurry-up (~20M). Named combos: **5-Way Time Loop** (Downtown x5 → left ramp, +15s ball save) and **Fastball Special** (right inlane → left ramp 500k → Sentinel 2.5M). Universal money loop: score a Super Jackpot then combo the **Danger Room exit ramp** for a 2x super that resets jackpots at a higher base — richest in Berzerker MB.
Multipliers

**Gambit bumper** (every 3 hits or an alley pass) = next mode/MB shot 2x (3x with the Smuggled Cargo perk). **Bonus X** is built at the Cerebro bonus targets near the left flipper and via skill shots. **Danger Room Lvl 1** doubles the next mission.
Wizard modes

**Save Senator Kelly** (mini-wizard) = complete all 8 missions; escalating green→yellow→orange→red phases started at Midtown/Subway, highest combo multiplier reached multiplies the rest of the mode. **Master Mold** is the intended Sentinel-themed final wizard but is a placeholder not yet fully implemented in shipped code.
Editions

All editions share the Danger Room, articulated Sentinel head (magnet + mouth), Cerebro, and crossing-shot layout. Prem/LE add the rising/fighting Sentinel body (extended hands that attack the ball / block ramps) and the elevated Beast's Lab captive-ball vari-target (a leaper/standup on Pro). Note: this 2024 game has NO physical ball lock, no Magneto Multiball, and no Dark Phoenix mode — those belong to the older X-Men (2012).

name: Metallica Remastered
description: Metallica Remastered pinball rules: collect the four items, stack the Fuel and Snake 2x multipliers, run all four multiballs, and reach End of the Line.

body.text: A 2024 remaster of John Borg's 2013 classic. Same physical playfield/flow; new code by Raymond Davidson (22 songs, Insider Connected, expression lighting). Editions (Pro/Premium/LE) share shot geometry — only the Coffin lock, Hammer/Gavel, Grave Marker motor and Sparky throw-magnet differ mechanically. The topper unlocks the "…And Justice For All" multiball.
Core economy

Four collectible **items** — Electric Chairs, Grave Markers, Snakes, Coffins — drive everything. Collect **12 of each** (+1 per Crank It Up already played) to light **Crank It Up** at the scoop. Items are spotted by direct feature shots or by the **light-blue "Spider" arrow** system: shooting a feature lights its insert at whatever major shot the Spider sits on, then the Spider moves. Coffins can ONLY be collected at the captive ball.
The 5 major / combo / Hardwired shots (left→right)
Left Orbit → Left Ramp → Center/Sparky → Right Ramp → Right Orbit. Comboable shots are those plus the Captive Ball and Grave Marker drops; the **Dead End lane** is the combo terminator/cash-out.
Skill shots

Standard: plunge the flashing rollover (200k, +50k each, right lane 2×). **Super Skill Shot**: hold LEFT flipper (kills the orbit up-post) then collect at any major shot for 2× +100k. Best target = **Dead End → instantly lights 2× Playfield**.
The four main multiballs

- **Electric Chair (Sparky)** — 10 Sparky hits (+3 each replay). Jacob's Ladder → Super Jackpot at Sparky. - **Grave Marker** — 3 inline drops, then the grave-marker magnet. Double/Super Jackpot with a 30s magnet hold. - **Snake** — spot SNAKE, then start a 2-ball MB; Snake Combo multiplier maxes at 3×. - **Coffin** — captive-ball hits (5/10/15 locks); uniquely can stack a second MB inside it. Universal rule: in ANY multiball, complete the **4 Pick / 72 Seasons standups** to light the Snake for a **2× Playfield lock + add-a-ball (first per MB)**. Also: Frantic MB (10 setlist pairs) and topper-only …And Justice For All.
Multipliers (stack to 4×)
**Fuel 2×** (complete FUEL → Dead End, 20s) and **Snake 2×** (4 Picks during MB). Both live = 4×. Bonus X is raised by the inline Grave Marker drops.
Combos & money sequences

Each combo = 250k + 500k×(length beyond 2-way) + 7.5k×(prior combos this ball). **14 named Setlist Combos** boost the Combo Jackpot, cashed by ending a combo at the **Dead End** (base 750k, snowballs +250k per chained shot). The three 750k loop combos — Left Loop→Left Loop (Fuel), Right Loop→Right Loop (Blackened), Left Loop→Left Ramp ("One"/Lady Justice) — are the top farms. 5 pairs → Lux Aeterna; 10 pairs → Frantic MB.
Modes (single-ball)
Lady Justice (spell METALLICA on ramps), Hardwired Hurry-Up, 72 Seasons, FUEL Frenzy, Seek & Destroy, Coffin Hurry-Up, Lux Aeterna.
Crank It Up (mini-wizard)

Pick one of four song modes (For Whom The Bell Tolls, Fade to Black, Battery, Enter Sandman). Cash out (L flipper) or continue (R flipper) at the scoop. Play all four → **End of the Line** wizard mode.
Wizard modes

items: **Blackened** — play all four main MBs (levels the band members), then start at the scoop (4-ball).
**End of the Line** — play all four Crank It Up modes; supers = 25% of your CIU scores lowest→highest; both 2×s apply. Biggest score on the machine.
**The Unforgiven** — super-wizard requiring maxed band members, victory laps, a Blackened super, 50 combos and all setlist pairs.

name: Star Wars: Fall of the Empire
description: Star Wars: Fall of the Empire pinball rules: run the eight Rebel Missions, build the Ion Cannon multiplier, and win Battle of Hoth and Death Star Multiball.

body.text: Designer John Borg. Original-trilogy "Empire" era. Editions: Pro / Premium / LE (Premium and LE share rules; edition-specific items marked `premium-le`). Classic Stern fan layout: 2 flippers, **8 main character shots** (each mapped to a Rebel — Yoda=left orbit, Lando=Death Star ramp, Luke=VUK, Droids=Droids target, Han=center ramp, Chewbacca=Sarlacc Pit, Leia=right ramp, Obi-Wan=right orbit), a Darth Vader scoop, Sarlacc Pit (guarded by the Salacious Crumb drop target), Stormtrooper target, a bank of 5 FORCE standups, two Ion Cannon pop bumpers, two orbit spinners (JEDI), and three Empire return lanes.
Core progression

items: **Skill Shots:** plunge and make any lit shot. Within a couple switches = Super Skill Shot (2x). Base 1M and each skill shot multiplies future ones. Left orbit adds 2 JEDI letters. Re-lit by Death Star locks or Jedi Saves.

**Rebel Missions (character modes):** spell **FORCE** to light the 8 character shots; hit one to start that Rebel's mission (8 difficulty levels, 3 tier colors). Every mission needs **4 blue shots then a 5th shot to Luke VUK** to complete. A character that already completed a mission restarts at 2x value.

**Rebel Combos / Rebel Assistance:** outside multiball, making a shot lights natural yellow combo shots from that flipper. Collecting a character combo (pulsing = 2 jackpots, solid = 3) pre-loads multiball value — the core reason to combo. Making the same combo twice starts that character's **Super Mode**.

body.text: Multiballs

items: **Battle of Hoth:** Droids light-lock target lights locks at Luke VUK (3 balls). Jackpots start 500K (+250K); AT-AT Letter Jackpot = sum of all jackpots; complete AT-AT → Luke VUK Super Jackpot.

**Death Star:** Death Star ramp opens/locks 3 balls. 8 shots for jackpots; at **15 jackpots** (Tilt v0.96; v0.87 says 14) the Death Star lights a 30s Super Jackpot (adds a ball, revives save) → Victory Laps.
**Lightspeed (Falcon feature #1):** qualify the Falcon, build at other shots, start at center ramp, then loop the center ramp for repeated super jackpots. Only multiball that stacks (with Hoth).
**Mynock `premium-le`:** third Dark Side Mystery award; bash the lowered center ramp (~10M each), 10th shot lights an Extra Ball.

body.text: Other pillars

items: **Millennium Falcon Features:** Lightspeed → That's No Moon → Dogfight → Never Tell Me The Odds (mini-wizard) → Welcome to Cloud City.
**Jabba Events:** Salacious Crumb drop target ×2 lights the Sarlacc Pit; Luke's Gift / Jabba's Palace / Rancor (untimed, highest value). All three → Sarlacc Escape mini-wizard.
**Vader Modes / Dark Side:** Empire return lanes alternately light Dark Side Mystery or a Vader Mode at the Vader scoop. 15 Dark Side awards qualify Dark Side Multiball (mini-wizard).
**TIE Fighter ramps / Hyperspace Loops:** right ramp = +1 TIE (+2 comboed from center on `premium-le`); Hyperspace Loops at 5/15/45, Extra Balls at 10/30/60.

body.text: Multipliers

No global playfield X. Instead: **Ion Cannon shot multiplier** (charge pop bumpers outside MB → next shot becomes 2x for the ball, roving 3x once all 8 majors hold a 2x); **Rebel Assistance** jackpot 2x/3x in multiball; **Bonus X** driven by Stormtrooper Hurry-Ups (cap 15X); and per-mission 2x quick-flashing-arrow shots.
Mini-wizards
Not A Jedi Yet (Rebel), Sarlacc Escape (Jabba), Never Tell Me The Odds (Falcon), Dark Side Multiball (Vader). A grand "Jedi Master" wizard is headered but not yet in code.
Edition notes

`premium-le`: motorized center ramp (lowers to a bash target), Mynock Multiball, +2 TIE combo, magnet grab-and-toss JEDI save (arms at 2/4 letters), center-ramp target raises the Falcon. Pro: fixed jump ramp, Falcon qualifies via right ramp only (except first feature), JEDI save needs all 4 letters then an action-button press.

name: The Walking Dead Remastered
description: The Walking Dead Remastered pinball rules: kill 115 Walkers, run Prison and Blood Bath Multiball, build the shot multiplier, and reach Last Man Standing.

body.text: Designer **John Borg**; code by the late **Lyman Sheats Jr.**, Mark Guidarelli & team. SPIKE 3, 18.5" HD display. Released **Premium ($9,699) and LE ($12,999, 500 units) only — no Pro**, so every mechanic that was Premium/LE-exclusive on the 2014 original (crossbow, Prison magnet, Well Walker toy, raised Bicycle-Girl ramp target, Flamethrower spinner) ships on **every** Remaster unit. Gameplay/shots are identical across Premium and LE; LE differences are cosmetic (mirrored backglass, armor, shaker, expression lighting). Code rev ~0.93.
Core system — Walker Kills & Shot Multiplier

items: White crosshairs at major shots **kill Walkers** and bump the counter above the flippers. **Three shots stay lit at once**, so you can't chain kills on one target.
**Kill 115 Walkers** → lights the **Last Man Standing** wizard mode.

**Shot Multiplier:** every **2 kills** lights an inlane "X"; roll it for a **next-shot 2X**. Skip it to bank **+1X per extra 2 kills** (no known ceiling), but it **resets to 2X on use and to nothing on a drain**. Flipper buttons choose which inlane/outlane the X is offered at.
**Multi-Kill phases** (yellow inserts) kill **2 Walkers per shot** regardless of multiplier.

body.text: Dead Features (five timed modes)

Qualify by clearing the **left drop-target bank** (1 completion for the first mode, 2 for each later mode; competition needs only 1). Start by shooting the lit major shot: **Barn** = left orbit, **CDC** = left ramp, **Riot** = Riot/Tower shot, **Tunnel** = railroad shot, **Arena** = right ramp. 40s timer, +10s per extra drop clear. Non-mode "crosshair" shots build the running mode +500k. **CDC (left-ramp loop)** is the top single-ball earner (~30–40M if clean); **Arena (right-ramp loop)** carries the highest base but is dangerous; **Riot** grows on switch hits, so it's the best mode to stack into a multiball. Completing all five then re-qualifying lights **Escape Terminus** (6th feature / mini-wizard, five hurry-ups at ~20% of prior mode scores).
Multiballs

items: **Prison MB (3-ball):** bash doors to spell **P-R-I-S-O-N** (first 5 letters spotted → only ~3 shots to start). Clear the Prison Yard, collect Walker-head jackpots, then a Super → Phase Two ramp-build. Highest base value; carries a **2X playfield** window. Spelling PRISON in **two** Prison MBs lights **Siege**.
**Well Walker MB (2-ball):** spell **WELL** via Well shots/switch hits, 5th activation engages the magnet and starts it. Jackpots scale with switch hits (feed the pops). Weak alone.

**Blood Bath MB (2-ball, long ball save):** collect a full **Supply set** (First Aid→Weapons→Food) at the drop bank. The **only multiball that stacks freely** (even during Prison/Well Walker) and the **only one with add-a-balls** (two on the first two drop clears). Note: **Prison + Well Walker can NOT stack together.**

body.text: Multipliers

items: **Shot Multiplier** (inlane X, above).
**2X Playfield:** complete the **stab targets** flanking the Prison to light the **Tower** standup (reached via a strong Riot shot); starts ~30s of 2X scoring. 10 lit-Tower shots → Extra Ball.
**Bonus Multiplier:** completing the **top lanes** advances Bonus X (max 250X).

body.text: Combos (money sequences)

Only **four** chains register (flashing red arrows, single-ball play): **L ramp→L orbit**, **L ramp→Riot**, **Tunnel→R ramp→Tunnel** (loop), **R ramp→Tunnel→R ramp** (loop). Each combo = **500k + 37.5k**; **every 10 combos starts a Multi-Kill**.
Wizard / mini-wizard modes

items: **Last Man Standing** (main wizard): kill 115 Walkers → light at Woodbury; 4-ball MB, kill another 115 (1M +400k per kill), 100M completion bonus, loopable.
**Siege:** spell PRISON in two Prison MBs; untimed, continues across drains.
**Horde:** light all six Multi-Kill inserts → start at Woodbury; a Walker reaching you ends the ball.
**Crossbow Frenzy:** 3 successful crossbow shots; 30s ball save, final bonus up to ~200M.

body.text: High-score philosophy

Qualify drops → run a strong mode (CDC/Riot) → **stack it with a multiball** (Prison, then Blood Bath for add-a-balls) → bank Walker kills into a fat X and dump it on a 2X-playfield jackpot → build two Prison spellouts for Siege and 115 kills for Last Man Standing. Bare multiballs are weak; the mode+MB stack with a big X is where every huge game is made.

name: Transformers: More Than Meets the Eye
description: Transformers pinball rules: complete the five Missions, build Combiners, run Transformers Multiball, and fight through to the Rescue Optimus wizard mode.

body.text: Designer **Elliot Eismin** (layout), code/rules **Elizabeth Gieske**. Released June 2026. Three editions — **Pro / Premium / LE** — with identical scoring; only physical toys differ (animatronic firing Megatron cannon, Soundwave physical ball lock, Grimlock sculpt, right-ramp diverter are `premium-le`). Playfield is split **Autobots-left / Decepticons-right**, three flippers including an **upper-right flipper** fed by the left orbit and plunge.
Core loops

items: **Missions (5):** Knock down the **3 drop targets** in front of Megatron, then shoot the **scoop/VUK** to start. Each is ~60s with a **final blow at Megatron**. Missions: *Autobot Run, Microbots, Solar Needle, Prime Target, Golden Lagoon*. Each has **Normal / Energized (easier, spend Energon) / Rusted (harder, higher scoring)** variants. A final blow grants a **2x Shot-X** on a random shot (pays when a Tech Spec is lit there).

**Transformers Multiball:** Shoot the **center VUK** to light/lock (6 VUK shots, 3 locks first MB). Shots cycle **purple → red → flashing jackpot** (3rd hit scores); lit jackpots multiply the next jackpot. **Super jackpot at the side ramp** after ~2 jackpots. Physical lock is `premium-le`; Pro uses virtual locks.

**Combiner Multiball:** Build 3 of 5 Combiners (5 parts each, from side ramp or matching Tech Specs), then shoot the **space bridge**. Cycle the spinner grid onto a completed Combiner for **8M→10M** jackpots; super at **side ramp + space bridge**.
**Tech Spec Mania:** Collect 3 of each of 5 colors (15) to start a utility 3-ball MB; farms Combiner parts.

**Dinobot Missions:** Hit the **2 Grimlock standups**, then **left orbit** on the orange arrow. War / Island (2-ball MB) / S.O.S.; 3 Dino Jackpots light **Dinobot Desertion** (all three → **Super Dinobot Desertion**).

body.text: Combos & multipliers

items: **Cassette Combos:** Roll the **left inlane** to light the Cassette target; chain **right ramp → left ramp → Cassette target** (3-way, base 3M) to qualify the action button for **all Tech Specs lit 15s**.
**Autobot Run combo:** **center spinner → left ramp → right orbit → left orbit → side ramp** (3x, 4x Rusted).
**Bumblebee Playfield X:** Hit the lit captive ball to spell BUMBLEBEE → **30s of 2x**. Stack with multiball **add-a-ball 2x** (space bridge → captive ball) for **3x**.
**Bonus X:** Advanced only via **Mystery award** (bumper → space bridge).

body.text: Skill shots

Soft-plunge to the upper flipper, then hit **Optimus (500K/+5s)**, **side ramp (5M/+8s)**, or **space bridge (8M/+10s)**. Secret: catch on right flipper → **left orbit** → upper-flipper shot = **15M/+10s**.
Wizard modes (code ~0.87)

Three mini-wizards top the ladder: **One Shall Fall** (play 2 missions → right ramp; 4-ball Megatron-vs-Optimus duel), **Rescue Optimus** (complete all 5 missions → VUK; 3 phases), **Dinobot Desertion / Super Dinobot Desertion**. No grand final wizard documented yet.

name: Cactus Canyon
description: Cactus Canyon pinball rules: rank up from Stranger to Marshal, win Quick Draw duels, run Gold Mine Multiball, and reach High Noon at the OK Corral wizard mode.

body.text: A wild-west game whose whole design points at one wizard mode: **High Noon at the OK Corral**. All CGC editions (SE / SE+ / LE) share one playfield and ruleset — differences are cosmetic, so every shot is trim `all`. The remake adds a right-orbit **spinner** and a rotating **saloon-doors** toy, present on all editions.

**The five major "fan" shots** carry the combo/jackpot logic: **Bronco Loop** (left orbit), **River Adventure Ramp** (left), **Train Ramp** (center), **Bank Robbery Ramp** (right) and the **Trick Shooting Loop** (right orbit). The two scoops are the **Gold Mine** (center-left) and the **Bart Brothers / Saloon** (upper right).

**Ranking (Stranger → Partner → Deputy → Sheriff → Marshal)** is the master multiplier: higher rank means higher Quick Draw values and far bigger High Noon totals, so the overriding strategy is *reach Marshal before spending your High Noons*. Rank up via **Bounty Awards** (collected at Bart), the **Lasso Skill Shot ("Increase Rank")**, or **winning a Gun Fight**.

**Core repeatable modes:** **Quick Draw** (reflex duel started by rolling a lit inlane; value counts down from a rank-based start to 50K; shooting all 4 Bad Guys in Quick Draw starts Showdown MB) and **Gun Fight** (rank-up duel; in the remake reworked into a cached AC/DC-style value that builds with every finished Shot Mode / defeated Bart and is collected at a lit inlane, but resets on drain).

**Multiballs:** **Gold Mine MB** (light lock at the Mine / Bounty / Skill Shot → lock 3 → 5-shot jackpots; the **Motherlode** is collected at the Mine and its multiplier grows +1× per full 5-jackpot sweep, cap 10×), **Showdown MB** (win Quick Draw on all 4 Bad Guys; Lyman adds Boss Bart → Super Jackpot at Bart → Victory Laps), **Stampede MB** (complete all 5 major shots), and Lyman's **Drunken MB** (Beer Mug, reversed flippers, Super Jackpot at the Beer Mug).

**Combos:** a Combo light sits on all 3 ramps + both loops; the window shrinks as the chain grows. **10 Combos** lights the Combo segment of the Sheriff's Badge. The Continued ramp-chain farms **50K per shot** ping-ponging the left/right ramps, capped by a Center-Ramp bonus of **25K × chain length**.

**Multipliers:** there is **no traditional playfield X**. The three multiplier systems are the **end-of-ball Bonus X** (back-left lanes / Skill Shot +3 / Bounty +5), the **Motherlode award multiplier** (all-5-jackpot sweeps in Gold Mine MB, cap 10×), and the **rank** effect on Quick Draw & High Noon.

**Wizard — High Noon:** complete the 5-segment **Sheriff's Badge** — Mother Lode, Showdown, 10 Combos, Stampede, and defeating the Barts — then shoot the lit **Gold Mine** to start. It runs 30s +1s per Bad Guy banked earlier in the game; **shoot 20 Bad Guy targets to win 20,000,000**. Lyman adds a second Boss-Bart finale stage. A great game is 3+ High Noons at Marshal plus a Gold-Mine-+-Showdown combined multiball with a maxed Motherlode, pushing past 1 billion.

name: Medieval Madness
description: Medieval Madness pinball rules: complete the five Madness modes, destroy all six castles, and reach the Battle for the Kingdom grand wizard mode finale.

body.text: **Designer:** Brian Eddy (rules), Lyman Sheats (software). The CGC 2015 remake and all its trims (Standard, Royal, Special/Limited, Merlin editions) are **rules- and layout-identical** to the 1997 original — cosmetic/hardware only. There is no Pro/Premium/LE split, so **every shot is `trim = all`**.
Objective

Destroy **6 castles** — five random King's Men castles, then the **King of Payne's** castle — while completing five single-ball "Madness" modes to fuel multiball, ultimately qualifying the wizard mode **Battle for the Kingdom**.
The Five Madness Modes (single-ball qualifiers)

items: **Joust Madness** — 3 orbit shots (joust the orbits into each other).
**Catapult Madness (Catapult Slam)** — 3 catapult slams at the castle.
**Peasant Madness (Revolting Peasants)** — 4 left ramps (Rabble Rouser → Angry Mob → Ugly Riot → Peasant Revolt).
**Damsel Madness (Save the Damsels)** — 4 right (dragon) ramps.
**Trolls! (Troll Madness)** — ~8 troll standup hits light Trolls!, then kill each raised troll 3×.

body.text: Completing a Madness flashes its light at Merlin's saucer (arming Multiball Madness). Completing one three times (10 trolls for Trolls) lights its blue "title" dot toward the wizard mode.
Multiballs

items: **Multiball Madness** — light as many Madnesses as possible, then start at **Merlin's saucer**. Ball count scales: 1 lit = 2-ball, 2-4 = 3-ball, all 5 = 4-ball. Typical values: Jackpots ≈ 100K, Super Jackpots ≈ 200K scaling to ~1M; the **Lock is a Double Super Jackpot** (up to 2M). Additive alternate model: Jackpots 75K +25K × lit, Super Jackpots 250K +150K × lit. Fold in castle shots — they out-value jackpots.
**Castle Multiball** — lock 3 balls in the castle (6 for later ones); 3-stage ramp→Super Jackpot loop (~750K ramp jackpots → 5 light a ~1.5M Super → all shots Super → loop with +250K/+500K base).
**Barnyard Multiball** — fling all five distinct catapult items (bowling ball, cow, chicken, cat, skull) into the castle; 3-ball with every switch worth 75K.

body.text: Castle Destruction (core progression)

Each castle is a 3-step kill: **moat** hits lower the drawbridge (hits = castle number) → **gate** ~3 hits to open (≈200K × castle number each) → one shot into the **castle interior** destroys it (≈2M × castle number). The 3rd castle lights an Extra Ball; the King of Payne's final castle is worth the most (~1M/gate + ~20M destroy).
Castle Hurry-Up

Completing a Madness after the first Multiball Madness (or via Super Skill Shot / Merlin's Magic) lights the gate for a hurry-up starting ~1M, decaying to ~250K. **Stack** further completions to build it "millions at a time" (1M → 3M → 5.5M → ~8M+; players hold to >50M), then cash at the castle. 10 hurry-ups light an Extra Ball (40 for a second).
Merlin's Magic

Random award at Merlin's saucer (lights when the three Merlin standups are completed): Light/Award Lock, Start Castle Multiball, Light/Start Trolls!, 3 Troll Bombs, Smack-A-Troll, +5 / Hold Bonus X, Light Extra Ball, 250K/500K/1M, Start Hurry-Up, Start any Madness, Lower Drawbridge, Destroy Gate/Castle, Video Mode.
Combos & Multipliers

items: **Troll Combo** — ricochet off a raised troll into a scoring feature/saucer for a Troll Bomb (3 bombs off both trolls). Bombs (launch button) clear immortal trolls in the wizard mode.
**Ultra Combo** — post-wizard Victory Laps; a second quick major shot doubles the lap value (up to ~4M), the highest repeatable ceiling.

**Bonus X** — no lane ladder; built via Normal Skill Shots (+5 each) and Merlin's Magic. Multiplies the switch-accumulating end-of-ball bonus (players reach ~100×). Jets add bonus switches that this Bonus X multiplier then scales; there is no separate playfield/shot multiplier. No 2X playfield.

body.text: Wizard Modes

items: **Royal Madness (mini-wizard)** — complete all five Madnesses and play Multiball Madness, then shoot the right eject; hit all lit shots in a resetting 20s timer (250K/750K), all = Extra Ball.

**Battle for the Kingdom (grand wizard)** — light all six blue dots (Joust Champion, Catapult Ace, Patron of the Peasants, Defender of Damsels, Castle Crusher, Master of Trolls), then shoot the castle. 4-ball with ~15s save: Phase 1 six ~2.5M Battle Jackpots, Phase 2 ~6-7 gate shots (~5M) clearing immortal trolls with Troll Bombs, ~50M finish, then Victory Laps/Ultra Combos.

body.text: Strategy

Castles are the scoring engine — the 60-second castle loop (moat → gate → castle, repeat) carries scores; weave in ramps/orbits to light Madnesses for a big Multiball Madness, then dump castles during it. Right drains are more common than left; the catapult is the hardest, most drain-prone shot. Battle for the Kingdom only lights in single-ball play, so guard the ball when one goal away.

name: Bone Busters Inc.
description: Bone Busters Inc. pinball rules: light random locks at Maxwell Street, run the game's only multiball, and farm the captive-ball spinner scoring engine.

body.text: **Machine:** Gottlieb/Premier model #719, designer Ray Tanzer, System 80B MPU, ~2,000 units, single production run. **No Pro/Premium/LE editions exist** — every shot uses trim `all`. Chicago-skeleton-invasion theme; 3-or-5-ball play; 4 pinballs installed.

**Controls (non-standard):** Two lower main flippers plus an **upper-right flipper** (lower extra right button) and a **Train Switch diverter/mini-flipper** (top extra right button). The upper flipper + Train Switch are the ONLY way to seat the lower-left **Headquarters** lock.
Multiball (the game's only multiball, 2-to-4 ball)

items: **Light a lock:** shoot **Maxwell Street** (left ramp) to light one of 3 random locks — Maxwell St, **Headquarters** (lower-left saucer), or **Moon Street** (lower-right saucer).
**Collect:** shoot Maxwell again; non-ramp locks feed the right ramp where the **Train Switch** diverts the ball to HQ or Moon St.
**Skill-shot double lock:** medium-plunge to the upper-right rollover to drop into Moon St (Lock 1); next plunge, hold the Train Switch to feed HQ (Lock 2) — two locks before a live shot.
**Start:** with any balls locked, shoot the **center ramp ("Long Jump")** to start multiball (up to 4-ball). The Long Jump start shot is difficult.

**Jackpots are switch-count based** — "wail on the spinners": **60 switches = 1M**, **90 = 2× Playfield** (rest of MB, excludes jackpots), **115 = 3 Specials** (3M in tournament). Strategy tip: repeat easy **2-ball multiballs** rather than chasing the harder 4-ball.

body.text: Award & collect systems (this modeless game's "modes")

items: **Captive ball ↔ spinner farm (primary engine):** hit the **captive/Messenger ball** to score the Jogging bonus and light the spinners for **20k/spin** (one rip); spinner un-lights after one shot, so alternate. Spinners build the Jogging bonus to a **159k** cap.
**Right loop ladder:** 50k → 100k → 200k → Extra Ball → Special (500k each once lit).

**Drop-target award selector** (the traffic-light target bank): the lit award is cycled by the **yellow spot target** and **lit inlanes** — Light Extra Ball, Light Special, **Light Opera Jackpot**, **Liz's Surprise** (pays current Jogging bonus). Clear the drops to collect the lit award.
**Opera Jackpot:** select "Light Opera Jackpot," clear the drops, then shoot the captive ball to collect a **progressive, game-to-game** jackpot (~250k floor, uncertain).
**Water Tower:** each pop-bumper hit builds the Water Tower bonus; the center-ramp jump into the Water Tower collects it.

body.text: Multipliers

items: **2× Playfield** is earned at **90 switches during multiball** (excludes jackpots) — the only documented multiplier. Cross 90 early so the rest of MB scores double. A separate normal-play bonus multiplier hasn't been confirmed.

body.text: Extra balls
Two paths, both cashed at the **right loop**: the 4th rung of the right-loop ladder, and drop-target "Light Extra Ball."
Wizard equivalent — the "Bonus Ball" frenzy

No named wizard mode. Draining a **LIT outlane** (which alternates side with switch hits) banks bonus time; after ball 3 you get a **2-ball frenzy worth 5k/switch** — rip spinners here for the finale.
End-of-ball bonus
The **Jogging bonus** (up to 159k) collects at end of ball or on demand via Liz's Surprise; Water Tower banks via the center ramp.

name: Iron Maiden: Legacy of the Beast
description: Iron Maiden: Legacy of the Beast pinball rules: win the five Eddie Battles, build Playfield X, run Trooper Multiball, and reach Run to the Hills wizard mode.

body.text: Designed by **Keith Elwin** (rules/code by Rick Naegele & Keith Elwin). You play as **Eddie** on a quest to defeat the Beast. Signature hardware: **4 flippers** (2 lower, 2 upper-mini for the loops), two spinners, a 3-bank of drop targets, a captive ball ("Sarcophagus"), a center **Bullseye** target, and 12 Iron Maiden songs. Editions: **Pro / Premium / LE** (Premium and LE share mechs).

**The shots:** Left Orbit, Left Ramp, Center/Pharaoh Ramp (jump ramp, the single most important shot — starts modes & multiballs), Mummy Captive Ball, Right Ramp, Right Orbit, plus two inner loops — **Big Loop** (mid-right flipper) and **Mini Loop** (upper-left flipper).

**Eddie Battle modes** — spell **E-D-D-I-E** on white arrows, then start at the center ramp. Five battles: *Fear of the Dark, Flight of Icarus, Hallowed Be Thy Name, Aces High* (2-ball) and *Rime of the Ancient Mariner* (2-ball). Winning any battle lights a **Soul Shard** at the Bullseye. The left spinner cycles which mode is queued before EDDIE completes.

**Multiballs:** - **Trooper** — complete the 3-bank drops (2 sweeps first time) to light orbit/loop locks; lock 3 to start. 3 jackpots light a Super Jackpot (color ladder Blue→Green→Yellow→Orange→Red = 1x→5x). The priority multiball. - **Mummy** — hit the Sarcophagus captive ball to spell M-U-M-M-Y, lock, spell again to start. - **Cyborg** (mini-wizard) — complete all **5 Power Features** (Spinners, Orbits, Ramps, Targets, Bumpers); cash the Power Jackpot at the **Orb**, then start at the Bullseye.

**Multipliers:** **Playfield X** — shoot the four orange **X** targets to qualify 2X (again for 3X); activate at a lit return inlane (~20–30s, +5s per X hit). **Bonus X** — advanced via the drop-target award cycle, maxes 50x.

**Money sequences:** the **Loop Jackpot farm** (200M+), the **6-Way Combo → Super Deathblow** (up to 900M), and the **Power Jackpot stack** (up to 5x × Playfield X at the Orb). Combos have **no timer** — chain distinct major shots at leisure.

**Progression to the wizard modes:** collecting Loop Jackpots, combos, Supers and Soul Shards lights **Tomb Treasures** (10-award ladder). All 4 **Eddie Cards** qualify **Number of the Beast** (100M + Soul Shards). The 10th Tomb Treasure starts the final **Run to the Hills** 6-ball wizard multiball. **2 Minutes to Midnight** is the mini-wizard after all five battles.
**Survival:** outlanes are the main killer — spell **R-E-V-I-V-E** on the left spinner early for outlane ball-saves (carries between balls), and lean on the center jump ramp as a safe bailout.

Pro and Premium/LE differ mainly on the Mummy lock location (center ramp vs left ramp), the Tomb collect shot (right loop vs left ramp), the Orb mechanism (standup vs captive/Newton ball), and the Premium/LE Underworld scoop under the center ramp.

name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
description: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles pinball rules: pick a turtle, run Ninja Pizza Multiball, complete the eight Episodes, and battle through to Cowabunga Multiball.

body.text: **Designer:** John Borg (code: Dwight Sullivan lineage; art: Zombie Yeti). Three editions — **Pro / Premium / LE**. Premium & LE share a playfield (LE adds cosmetics only) and add the player-steered **Glider** diverter, sculpted **TMNT Van** lock, **bidirectional magnetic Pizza Disc**, animated Krang, and the **Mushrooms** topping. Scoring is deliberately *low* — ~10M is a good beginner game, strong players hit 100M+.
Turtle Select (most important early choice)

Pick a turtle at start; each has a unique skill-shot target and a 4-level perk tree (levels earned via Training): - **Leonardo** → LAIR skill shot; Training lit immediately; multiball-scoring monster (2x Team-Up/Pizza Party). - **Raphael** → Left Ramp skill shot; **Start Episode lit** from ball 1; L3 **3x Playfield**, L4 3x Episodes → stacks to ~9x. Tournament/high-score favorite. - **Michelangelo** → Pizza Parlor skill shot; **Battle Again outlane save lit** + 5 pizza slices. Survivability pick. - **Donatello** → Center Ramp skill shot; **Turtle Power MB lit instantly**.
Core scoring loops

items: **Skill Shots:** hit your turtle's lit shot in a 15s window = 250k + lights Weapon Hurry-Up. Pro-only: soft-plunge the flashing top lane for +1x Bonus Multiplier.

**Ninja Pizza Multiball (the scoring engine — priority above all):** lock 3 at the Pizza Parlor → balls release onto the spinning disc → defeat 6 Foot Soldiers (Left Ramp=3 Foot, Krang Loop=2, Center Ramp=2, Parlor=1, Right Ramp=1) → Mondo Jackpot at Krang/upper loop (~500k +250k) → Super "Jackpoto Grande" at the Lair (3M + 500k/Mondo). Toppings chosen at the pizza standups at lock modify the MB.
**Turtle Power Multiball:** shoot the Right Ramp 3x, 4th starts it → green jackpots (100k, +25k, max 250k) → 4 → Mondo at upper loop → Super at Lair.

**Episodes (8 timed modes):** Left/Right Ramp lights "Start Episode," then Pizza Parlor starts it. Completing episodes qualifies **Team-Up Multiball** (4 episodes, lit at Left Ramp) then **Final Battle** (all 8, lit at Pizza Parlor).
**Krang Kombo:** upper-loop ×3 builds to 500k, cash on the center/side ramp (upper-flipper fed). A Cowabunga requirement.
**1-2-3 Foot:** lit at right inlane; Right Ramp → then Center Ramp → Left Ramp OR Upper Loop → Center Ramp. 6x Foot Value; Cowabunga requirement.
**Weapon Hurry-Up / April Hurry-Up:** low-value cash hurry-ups; both are Cowabunga checkboxes (Weapon once, April ×5).

body.text: Multipliers

items: **2x Playfield** lit by even LAIR completions (odd = Training); 30s, +5s per center target. **Raphael L3 = 3x.** Light it, bank it, and trigger right before NPMB / a big episode / Final Battle.
**Bonus X** advanced by the Pro top-lane skill shot and Pict-o-Pop awards (~10x cap).
Training gives +10%/win (cap +30%) global boost stacked with everything.

body.text: Wizard progression

Multiballs don't re-light until **Team-Up** is completed, forcing the ladder. **Final Battle** (all 8 episodes) pays accumulated episode scores × 2x/3x Playfield — can exceed 60M. **Cowabunga Multiball** (final wizard) needs all 7: reach Final Battle, max Krang Kombo, 5 April Hurry-Ups, a Weapon Hurry-Up, complete 1-2-3 Foot, a Jackpoto Grande, and a Triple Mondo.

name: Star Wars
description: Star Wars pinball rules: pick a character, build the Shot Multiplier up to 40x, complete four planet missions, and reach the Jedi Multiball wizard mode.

body.text: **Design:** Steve Ritchie (code lead Dwight Sullivan). Editions: **Pro / Premium / LE** — Premium and LE share a playfield. Core rules are identical across editions; only the **Hyperspace hyperloop wireform**, **exploding Death Star**, sculpted **Millennium Falcon**, and the physical **Escape** ball-save gate are Premium/LE-only (tagged `premium-le`).

**The ~9 shots the rules reference:** Left Orbit, Left Ramp, Left mini-loop, Right mini-loop, Right Ramp, Right Orbit, Right Scoop, the 5-target **FORCE** drop bank, and the center **3-bank** standups. Planets map to shots: **Death Star = left mini-loop**, **Endor = left ramp**, **Hoth = right mini-loop**, **Tatooine = right scoop**.

**Character select (ball start):** Luke (doubles Lightsaber Duel), Leia (+3x on final planet modes), Han (doubles Escape from Boba Fett; fast to multiballs), R2-D2 (easier/wider multipliers with 7x/14x thresholds — the tournament pick).

**Shot Multiplier (scoring engine):** starts 2x, +1x per 3-bank standup hit up to **20x** base; the 4th FORCE award **Double Multipliers** lifts the cap to **40x**. It decays if you stop feeding the 3-bank. The action/lockbar button toggles the lit "X" green (locked) / red (movable) — flip the X onto your money shot, collect value × multiplier. Spread shrinks as it climbs (3 shots <5x, 2 shots 5–9x, 1 shot 10x+).
**FORCE ladder (complete the 5-drop bank):** Mystery → Escape (ball save) → Video Mode → Double Multipliers → Lightsaber Duel.

**Multiballs:** TIE Fighter MB (destroy TIEs at the 3-bank, hurry-up at the TIE target, 35 to start), Hyperspace MB (cycle inlanes → hurry-up at Left Orbit collected at the Death Star mini-loop), and per-planet **Victory Multiballs** (finish a planet's missions → final mode → Victory MB; Death Star yields a 6-ball). Victory MBs bank bronze/silver/gold **medals** paid out before the wizard.

**Wizard path — Jedi Multiball:** requires (1) Jedi Master via Jedi Training, (2) Lightsaber Duel, (3) Escape from Boba Fett, (4) 100 TIE Fighters destroyed, (5) all four planet final multiballs. Then it lights at the Left Ramp — a 2-ball, 4-phase duel with the Emperor.
**Skill shots:** primary = flashing center 3-bank (Bonus X), secondary = roving lit FORCE drop (spots next FORCE award); ricochet the 3-bank into the roving FORCE light for a double.

name: Elvira's House of Horrors
description: Elvira's House of Horrors pinball rules: start Haunts at the Mansion Entrance, build Double Trouble, run Gappa Angry Multiball, and try to sell the house.

body.text: **Designer:** Dennis Nordman (layout) / Lyman Sheats (lead code). Two-flipper, single-level, B-movie house-party theme. **No Pro model** — shipped as Premium, LE (400), Signature (50), and Blood Red Kiss; all editions share an **identical playfield, mechs, and ruleset**, so every shot is `trim: all`.
The core loop — HAUNTS

The spine of the game is starting **Haunts** (B-movie modes). Repeatedly shoot the **House/Mansion Entrance** (center) until its insert flashes purple, then the next House shot **starts** the qualified Haunt; the **Super Secret Back Door** skill shot instantly qualifies/starts one for free. Haunts run a **45s timer that pauses in the pop bumpers** (resets to 15s if you make progress under 15s). There are **6 main Haunts** (Night of the Living Dead, Teenagers from Outer Space, The Brain That Wouldn't Die, The Manster, Manos: The Hands of Fate, The Werewolf of Washington) plus **4 Skeleton-Key-locked Haunts**. Completing a Haunt qualifies **Trailer Trash** (hurry-up worth 50%→75%→100% of the Haunt score depending on ramps hit) and advances **B-Restorator rank** toward Director's Cut.
Skill shots

items: **Dead End / Top-Lane skill shot** (safe): 250k +25k/time **plus +5X bonus multiplier**.
**Super Secret Back Door** (high value): 1M base, +250k/time, max 2.5M, and **qualifies/advances a Haunt**.

body.text: Multiballs

items: **Garage Multiballs** (Wild Women → Add-a-Zombie → Attic Attack) — lock via the gravestone drop target into the Garage.
**Junk in the Trunk** — complete the 36-24-36 stand-up bank to open the Trunk, lock via the crate-diverter Left Ramp; 2 balls → Trunk MB; all 4 Junk items → Phone-A-Fiend MB.
**Deadhead Family Crypt** — the Crypt Cleaner battle track (defeat Deadheads via crypt/skull hits).

**Freak Fryer → Gappa Angry** — charge Freak Fryer with switch hits (5 levels) to light Gappa Angry, a 6-stage lock progression culminating in a 6-ball MB at the Cellar; draining mid-Gappa yields consolation MBs (Pool Party, Dance Fever, Make-Out Mayhem, Scream Test, Run For Your Life).

body.text: Multipliers

items: **Double Trouble** — complete the Trunk targets AND Hand of Fate targets, then roll a lit inlane for **2X playfield (30s); re-qualify while running → 4X**.
**Bonus multiplier** — built +5X per Dead End skill shot; **Double Bone-Us** (Hand of Fate wheel) doubles the entire end-of-ball bonus.

body.text: Side modes / collect systems
**Un-Happy Hour** (ramps), **Drive Me Crazy** (orbits), **Gar-Goils Gone Wild** (Gar-Goil targets + orbits), **Hand of Fate wheel** (collected at left outlane), **Manos Wheel**.
Wizard modes

items: **House Party** (mini-wizard) — start 3 Haunts.
**They Came From Space** (wizard) — start 6 Haunts; complete all 6 phases = 100M.
**Director's Cut** (wizard) — complete 4 Haunts; re-collect films at the Cellar = 100M.
**Wild Market Value** (final wizard) — achieve all 7 subsystem requirements; a ~30s hurry-up at the Cellar to "sell the house."

body.text: **Tournament money:** stack a **Haunt + a jackpot multiball under a held 4X Double Trouble**, loop multiball supers via the House relight, and 100% every Trailer Trash.

name: Avengers: Infinity Quest
description: Avengers: Infinity Quest pinball rules: collect the six Infinity Gems, build Portal Locks, run Thor and Iron Man Multiball, and battle Thanos for the Gauntlet.

body.text: Keith Elwin design. Collect the **six Infinity Gems** through **Gem Quests**, place them in the Gauntlet, and build toward the **Battle for the Gauntlet** wizard mode. Central toy is **Dr. Strange's motorized spinning disc** (spin it to spell **S-T-R-A-N-G-E** and qualify quests). Three editions — Pro / Premium / LE; only Premium/LE have the physical **subway portal ball-lock** under the disc (Pro simulates locks virtually).
Core loops

items: **Gem Quests** (Mind, Power, Space, Time, Reality; Soul is earned separately): qualify with STRANGE → shoot right ramp/portal → pick a quest. Quests are **untimed** but governed by a draining health bar. Fail and **Thanos claims that Gem** for the final battle.

**Combos**: after any major shot, other major shots flash white — chain them. A cumulative counter awards **Portal Locks (4 & 10 combos)**, Combo Jackpots, and Trophies. **Hawkeye Combos** (right ramp ×3 → upper loop) are a separate track.

**Portal Locks** are the primary scoring multiplier: **1 lock = 2×, 2 locks = 3×** quest scoring while balls remain in play. Tournament core loop: bank two locks, stack Thor/Iron Man multiball into a quest to keep the 3× alive, finish the quest for **Victory Laps**, then **place the Soul Gem on a leveled Avenger** to cash out.

body.text: Multiballs

items: **Thor** — spell THOR at the captive ball (easiest, always available from ball 1).
**Iron Man** — spell I-R-O-N via **disc spins** (not lane change), lock 3 balls at the Tower.
**Sanctum/Portal** [Premium/LE] — physical subway lock under the disc; brings a multiball into a quest for 2×/3×.
**Black Order**, **Computer Frenzy**, **Gem Mania**, and celebration **Super Victory Laps** are later/mini-wizard multiballs.

body.text: Multipliers

items: **Portal Locks** → 2×/3× quest scoring. **Reality Gem** → shot multiplier on a placed shot. **Bonus X** (max 25×) via pop bumpers + Computer-Grid "+5× Bonus". Avenger **Lvl-2** perks give a permanent 2× to that Avenger's shot.

body.text: Wizard modes

items: **Battle for the Gauntlet (Battle Thanos)** — attempt all 6 Gem Quests + play all 3 mini-wizards → 4-ball MB, defeat Thanos at the Tower → 6-ball Super Victory Laps.
**Trophy Mania** (hidden final) — collect 24 of 32 Trophies, then shoot the right ramp.

name: Led Zeppelin
description: Led Zeppelin pinball rules: pick a song, build the Icarus X playfield multiplier across four target banks, run Zeppelin Multiball, and reach Celebration Day.

body.text: Steve Ritchie's final Stern design (rules/code by Tim Sexton). Editions: **Pro**, **Premium**, **LE (500 units)**. Premium and LE share one playfield; edition-only features are marked `premium-le`, everything else `all`.

**Core loop — Songs & Records.** Each ball you pick one of **10 song modes**, which runs the whole ball and lights shots dynamically by section (intro/verse/chorus/solo). Making lit shots earns **Record Sales**; every 100K = **1 Gold Record**. **5 gold records completes a song, 10 = Platinum.** Completing/changing a song lights **Change Song** at the right orbit and awards **2 Band Boosts**.
**Skill shot.** After song select, time the plunge to the **moving L-E-D target** (it sweeps left↔right). Award: **500K + 5 sec ball save.**

**Icarus X — playfield multiplier.** Combos (lit shots in quick succession) are cashed by hitting any of the four target banks (**LED, ZEP, ROCK, Ball-Save**), adding **+0.1× per combo shot** to that bank. **Icarus X = the product of all four bank multipliers**, so you build them **evenly** (always feed the lowest). Once all four banks are raised, the center **Icarus standup** lights the timed playfield multiplier (~15 sec, +5 sec per side-flipper shot); shooting Icarus during the window recalculates it live.

**Band Boosts (action button).** Start with 1, earn more by completing/changing songs (max 5). Single boost = **5× combo value** into the lowest bank; **Super Band Boost** (3+ saved) = **10×** into the two lowest banks. In multiball they spot an Icarus hit / instantly add a ball.

**Zeppelin Awards (upper/side-flipper shots).** Each side shot starts the next super feature — Super Spinner → Super Pops → Super Slings → Super Ramps — and adds +5 sec to the Icarus X timer. **8 Zeppelin Awards lights an Extra Ball** at the left eject.

**Multiballs.** - **Zeppelin MB (all):** left ramp 3× to lock, next left ramp starts a 4-ball; relight later locks by spelling R-O-C-K. Jackpots → doubles → super at left eject + side shot (side = 2× eject). Add-a-ball via Icarus 3×. - **Tour MBs (all, four of them):** right ramp qualifies (increasing), pick a tour at the left eject, complete 4 objectives, start at the left eject. US 1975 / US 1977 / Earl's Court / UK 1971. - **Electric Magic MB (premium-le only):** complete LED then ZEP to raise the magic-wand spinner, charge it and lock. Leads to the **Electric Magic Frenzy**, the biggest single-mode farm on Prem/LE (right orbit doubles jackpots).

**Wizard ladder.** Mothership (5 songs → right orbit) → World Tour (all 4 Tour MBs → left eject, 6-ball, City Jackpots) → Top of the Charts (all 10 songs → right orbit, platinum chase) → **Celebration Day** final wizard (all 10 songs platinum → right orbit; ends with a **Diamond Record** that adds +1× to end-of-ball bonus).
**Bonus.** Bonus X built via the ROLL inlanes (lane change, max 50×). 5 extra balls on default, all collected at the left eject.

name: No Fear: Dangerous Sports
description: No Fear: Dangerous Sports pinball rules: climb the Challenge ladder, farm the magnetic Jump Ramp, run Regular Multiball, and reach Meet Your Maker wizard mode.

body.text: Steve Ritchie fast, wide-open shooter's game. WPC-DCS, DMD. **Single production run — no Pro/Premium/LE editions**, so every shot and rule is `trim: all`. Defining traits: **no pop bumpers**, three flippers (two lower + one upper-right "Jumps" flipper), and a magnetically-accelerated **Jump Ramp/Jump Loop** that is the single biggest scoring shot in the game.

Despite claims sometimes seen elsewhere, "Danger Zone," "Meltdown," and "Super Kickback" do **not** exist on No Fear. "Payback Time" is real but is a **25-second timed mode**, not a wizard. The actual wizard mode is **Meet Your Maker** (4-ball).
The Challenge ladder (the mode spine)

Five **Minor Challenges** (Dirt, Asphalt, Water, Snow, Air) → two **Major Challenges** (No Limits, then Fear Fest) → **Meet Your Maker** wizard. Start a challenge by shooting the **Skull** scoop when "Start Challenge" is lit, or via the plunge skill-shot cycle. Each challenge STARTED banks +10M end-of-ball bonus. Good players deliberately time out the low-value minors to climb to the majors and the wizard.
Multiballs

items: **Regular (3-ball):** Drop the Skydive drop target to light Lock at Skydive **and** Skull; lock 3 balls (12M each). Jackpots run **Skull 50M → Skydive 100M → Jump Super Jackpot 200M**, repeating.
**Over the Edge (2-ball):** Qualified from the Steering Wheel 1st-Place award (#3) or a Tube award. Jump/Hairpin ramps 25M +10M/shot, max 75M. Best stacked with Payback Time.
**No Limits (Major, 3-ball):** All major shots 20M base, +1M/shot up to 70M.
**Fear Fest (Major, 3-ball):** Skull/Skydive jackpot 50–80M start, +20M/major shot.

**Meet Your Maker (wizard, 4-ball):** Everything lit. Skull 50M; **each Jump Loop = 200M Super Jackpot that STAYS LIT** — cradle balls on the left flipper and hammer the loop from the upper-right flipper for repeated 200M supers.

body.text: Combos / money sequences

**Super Cross** = alternate Jump Ramp ↔ Hairpin Ramp for **15M each**; a Hairpin→Jump order lets the magnets grab and re-feed the ball. Three alternating shots on each ramp lights **Payback Time** (all majors 25M for 25s). Consecutive Jump Ramps build **5M→25M** (flat 25M in multiball) and each Jump permanently adds **+5M to end-of-ball bonus** (carries the whole game). **Jump This!** triggered at the left outlane while the Kickback is lit becomes a **2-ball multiball** for 30M-per-jump farming.
Scoring builds (no true multipliers)

No Fear has **no playfield X, no bonus multiplier, and no per-shot multiplier**. Scoring escalates through value BUILDS instead: **Raceway** (Screamer/left orbit) 5M→20M→Light Extra Ball→25M; the **Steering Wheel** 3rd/2nd/1st-Place ladder up to 100M; Fear Fest +20M/shot; Summit and Jump builds.
End-of-ball bonus
5M per Jump made · 10M per Challenge started · 1M per 100 meters Climbed. No bonus multiplier.
Skill shot
Plunge cycles five options (Start Challenge / Super Cross Level / Advance Raceway / Ball Lock / Flipper Skill Shot). The premier shot: **Flipper Skill Shot → shoot the Jump Ramp for 50M**.
Safety
Left outlane has the **Kickback** (lit via the two Cliff standups, ~2.5M save) — keep it lit. Right outlane has no save.

name: The Munsters
description: The Munsters pinball rules: complete all five Family Areas, build the 6X playfield multiplier at Kitty, stack Super Jackpots, and reach Munster Madness.

body.text: **Designer:** John Borg · **Code:** Dwight Sullivan · **Editions:** Pro, Premium, LE. The only meaningful rules split is **Grandpa**: Pro plays *Enlarging Ray* on the main playfield; Premium/LE play *Grandpa's Laboratory* on a physical lower mini-playfield with its own flippers, orbits, ramp, saucer, and THE MACHINE bash target.
The Five Family Areas (progression spine)

Herman, Grandpa, Spot, Raven, and Lily. Starting/completing **one level of all five** qualifies the **Munster Madness** wizard mode. Every area start does two universal things: lights the **Kitty** target (playfield-X / bonus-X / Raven advance) and lights the **left ramp for a Raven advance**. Each area also has its own Super Jackpot collectable at the Dragula lane.

items: **Herman Multiball** — bash Herman to arm a hurry-up; a second hit locks the ball on the magnet; shoot it off to start (3 balls). Fastest MB, once per level.
**Spot** — spell S-P-O-T by alternating the two ramps, then bash the popped-up Spot toy 4x (150K/250K/350K/450K). Infamous for center drains.
**Grandpa** — light the scoop via chattering-teeth targets. Pro = *Enlarging Ray* (purple-target jackpots); Prem/LE = *Grandpa's Laboratory* lower-PF multiball via THE MACHINE.
**Raven Multiball** — collect 3 left-ramp Raven advances to start; the left-orbit spinner advances a clock that raises jackpot value toward midnight.
**Lily** — shoot the Lily target 4x to start an "Everything Scores" frenzy that stacks with almost everything; 100 switch hits lights its Super.

body.text: Scoring engine: 6X + stacked Super Jackpots

This is **not a combo/flow game**. Tournament players farm the **6X playfield multiplier** (built and held at the **Kitty** target, ~1-minute timer, tap Kitty to keep it alive) and **stacked Super Jackpots**. There are **10 (Pro) / 11 (Prem/LE)** independent Super Jackpot qualifiers (Herman, Spot, Lily, Grandpa/Enlarging Ray, Raven, Eddie, Marilyn, Zap, Mystery, Chattering Teeth, +Machine on Prem/LE) and **ALL of them stack** at the Dragula lane. Hold the **Zap button** (~1/3 sec) to cancel a collect and keep stacking, then dump the whole stack at 6X. A perfect Munster Madness cycle is community-cited at ~938M at 6X vs ~91M at 3X.
Side systems

items: **Zap button** (lockbar) — hit a purple mini-target (or THE MACHINE) to make it blink; press to charge a 5-slot meter; charged jackpot shots leave Zap Jackpots (every 4 → Zap Super).
**Eddie** — orbit loops, every 5 → Eddie Super. **Marilyn** — inner-left inlane lights right ramp; every 2 departures → rotating Super buff + Marilyn Super.
**Dragula bank** — spell D-R-A-G-U-L-A to light 5X Dragula. **Chattering Teeth** milestones drive bonus-X, Extra Ball, Secret Mania, and Super Jackpots.

body.text: Wizard: Munster Madness (4-ball)

Stage 1 complete areas for buffs → Stage 2 collect jackpots → Stage 3 four cascading hurry-ups in order **left ramp → right orbit → right ramp → left orbit**, each adding the previous value. Hidden **Secret Mania** (130 teeth or Mystery) lights all 7 areas.

name: KISS
description: KISS pinball rules: pick a song, build the Playfield Multiplier up to Colossal, run Demon and Love Gun Multiball, and reach Rock City, the final wizard mode.

body.text: Designed by John Borg on SPIKE-1 hardware, KISS is a shot-based, mode-and-multiplier scoring game built around eight setlist "songs," two competing multiballs, and a long band-insert wizard-mode chain. The physical layout is identical across Pro/Premium/LE except for two hardware swaps: the Demon head's ball lock (physical 3-ball on Premium/LE, virtual/disc on Pro) and the Love Gun captive-ball mech (Premium/LE only; Pro plays that phase with two loose balls).
No skill shot

KISS has no formally awarded skill shot. The only plunge-related techniques are two "cheese" exploits: a soft-plunge delay that pre-trips the left-orbit switch, and a right-loop re-entry trick where a ball falling back into the right loop can double-collect an award.
Songs (modes)

Eight untimed shot-sequence modes — Deuce, Hotter Than Hell, Lick It Up, Shout It Out Loud, Detroit Rock City, Rock and Roll All Night, Love It Loud, and Black Diamond — are selected at the Backstage Pass scoop ("New Track") at ball start or between shots. Progress carries ball-to-ball; you can't run two at once or select one during multiball. Deuce is the beginner-friendly opener (two lit shots migrate left-to-right, then alternate); Detroit Rock City and Hotter Than Hell are flagged as advanced/high-drain. Completing any song steps an untimed, ball-long **Playfield Multiplier**: 2x -> 3x -> 5x -> Colossal — the single biggest scoring lever in the game, since it's permanent for the ball and stacks with everything after it.
Multiballs

**Demon Multiball ("God of Thunder")** is qualified by completing the Lock targets flanking the Demon head, or spelling D-E-M-O-N at the Demon shot, then locking 3 balls (physically on Premium/LE, virtually on Pro). Six major shots pay 2 Jackpots each; the 6th and 12th collections are Super Jackpots, escalating to a roving Double Jackpot and Double Super Jackpot. Locking balls during Demon MB itself adds a temporary +2X/+3X playfield stack. It's the harder-to-start but more consistent-value multiball.

**Love Gun Multiball ("Flying Starchild")** is qualified by repeated STAR-target hits and launched via the right ramp or Starchild saucer as a 2-ball multiball. Premium/LE gates a 3rd ball behind a captive drop target Hurry-Up; Pro plays the Hurry-Up phase with 2 loose balls. All major shots pay Jackpot, then Double Jackpot, building to a Triple Jackpot at the right ramp and a ~50M Super Jackpot at the Starchild/STAR shot. It's faster to start but "sloppier" and lower-average-value than Demon.
**KISS Army Multiball** is a sub-wizard multiball, qualified once all four band-member inserts (Star Child, Space Man, Demon, Cat Man) reach their flashing state, started at the scoop.
Multiballs never stack with each other or with mode play — pick one lane and commit.
Combos and hurry-ups

Any shot immediately following another while its arrow is still flashing scores double ("combo"). Fifteen named **City Combos** (1M x number of shots) run from 2-shot (Chicago, Pittsburgh, Seattle, Portland) through 3-, 4-, and 5-shot chains up to the brutal 10-shot Detroit. Rolling the left inlane lights an **Army Combo**, making the ARMY bank flash as the combo target; rolling the right inlane lights a **Kiss Combo**, making the KISS bank flash. One hit on the flashing bank instantly completes the whole bank and lights a Hurry-Up — Army Hurry-Up collected at the center ramp, Kiss Hurry-Up collected at the left orbit. The only documented stack is collecting both a pending Army Hurry-Up and Kiss Hurry-Up in the same cycle, which awards a 2X Shot Multiplier.
Grid, bonus, and wizard chain

A 16-light Grid (KISS bank, ARMY bank, 4 pop-bumper tiers, 4 instruments) feeds end-of-ball bonus and, completed twice by default (adjustable down to one completion), qualifies **Heaven's on Fire**, a mini-wizard scoop mode built around re-clearing the grid for a Super Jackpot. The four band-member inserts each track a flashing (partial) and solid (complete) state; all four solid qualifies **Rock City**, the final wizard mode — an 8-stage, 3-ball multiball (Instrument -> Kiss Army -> Pop Bumper -> Demon -> Starchild -> Spinner -> World -> ~100M Final Shot at the scoop).
Strategy in one line

Bank playfield multiplier by finishing songs before starting a multiball, favor Demon Multiball for consistency once you have the choice, and lead every ball with Deuce + center ramp while spelling KISS early for outlane insurance.

name: Halloween
description: Halloween pinball rules: pick a Jack-O-Lantern mode, bank Blood for scoring boosts, run three story multiballs, and reach Boogeyman and The Night He Came Home.

body.text: Designed by Koris Barloff with code by Fawzma & Bug (later updates by Matt Kemp / Luke Peters), Halloween adapts John Carpenter's 1978 film across a five-lane fan of shots (left orbit, left ramp, center ramp, right ramp, right orbit) feeding two elevated mini-playfields — the **Strode House** (with flippers) and **Smith's Grove Sanitarium** (gravity-fed, no flippers) — plus a third, purely decorative diorama.
Skill Shots

Before plunging, cycle the flippers to pick which lit shot counts as the skill shot; harder/farther shots score more. There's also a **hidden secret skill shot**: cycling to the lower-right Judith lane target and hitting it off the plunge instantly traps the ball at the Judith Tombstone instead of requiring the usual 5 hits — a low-risk opener that banks Tombstone Multiball progress.
Jack-O-Lantern Modes

Eight story modes (Death in the Driver's Seat, Bob and Lynda's Demise, Counting Bodies, Escape the Kitchen, Let Me In, Laurie Slashes Back, Stalker, First Kill) are qualified by clearing the 3 center drop targets and shooting the right scoop to pick one. Winning two in a game lights an Extra Ball; winning enough (operator-configurable) qualifies the final wizard mode. After a set number of mode wins (default 3), the next scoop shot becomes **Jack-O-Lantern Multiball** instead of a mode pick.
Multiballs

Three "story" multiballs each carry a **Super Jackpot**: **Hedge Multiball** (lock a ball at each of three hedge scoops, then reveal-and-collect jackpots via the left ramp, with the middle hedge scoop lighting for the Super Jackpot once all three jackpots are collected), **Sanitarium Multiball** (a 4-step qualifying chain on the middle playfield — drop target, scoop, two standups, drop target, scoop — arms it for the next drain, and once all six patient jackpots are collected the middle-playfield entry scoop lights for a 500k Super Jackpot), and **House Multiball** (qualify House Attack via 5 center-ramp hits or the instant "Dirty Pool"/Eye of the Needle crossover shot, then beat Myers' and protect Laurie's health bars on the upper playfield under a 60-second clock). Once a multiball's Super Jackpot is scored, it can't be re-qualified until **Boogeyman** is cleared. Separately, the secret skill shot or 5 hits on the lower-right target lock a ball for **Tombstone Multiball** — a 2-ball, stackable multiball with a flat 2x scoring bonus.
Blood, Store & Scoring

Blood is Halloween's currency: 3 for lighting a mode, 6 for winning one. Banked blood grants a live scoring multiplier and unlocks a store at the Jack-O-Lantern scoop: 1 blood = 1M points, 10 blood = 2x scoring for the rest of the ball, 12 blood = an instant Extra Ball. There's no classic ladder-style playfield multiplier — scoring boosts instead come from banked blood, Tombstone Multiball's flat 2x, and the "Dirty Pool" loop (repeatedly threading the House-qualifying ramp cleanly for a stacking multiplier).
Combos

Left orbit, left ramp, center ramp, and right orbit all count as combo shots — alternating between them (never repeating one back-to-back) chains escalating value. The best repeatable "money" sequences are the House Multiball crossover reset loop (Super Jackpot relights everything on collection, effectively uncapped), the Hedge Multiball reveal-and-jackpot cycle, and — inside the final wizard mode — the knife-insert double-jackpot loop.
Wizard Modes

**Boogeyman** (mini-wizard): score the Super Jackpot in all three story multiballs, then relock all 6 balls across three phases (3 hedges, 2 scoops, 1 crossing shot) to fire a 6-ball finale with every major shot lit. **The Night He Came Home** (final wizard, added v1.14): qualified by a configurable number of completed Jack-O-Lantern modes; race through story locations against a fuel clock, collecting hurry-up location jackpots, knife-insert double-jackpots, and a 10-million-times-balls-in-play Super Jackpot at Judith Tombstone once per location.
Editions
Standard, Blood Sucker, and Collector's Editions all run identical code and playfield rules — differences are purely cosmetic/hardware trim (powder coat, knocker/shaker, speaker lighting, topper).

name: The Addams Family
description: The Addams Family pinball rules: tour the Mansion's 12 rooms, spell GREED to open the Vault for Multiball, and reach the Tour the Mansion grand wizard mode.

body.text: The best-selling solid-state pinball machine ever made (~20,270 units), designed by Pat Lawlor with the Mansion-tour theme driving every rule. There is no Pro/Premium/LE split — the only variant is the 1994 gold-cabinet **Special Collector's Edition ("TAF Gold," ~1,000 units)**, which is cosmetically different but shares the identical physical playfield, with a handful of ROM-level rules tweaks noted below.
Skill shot

The plunger feeds a curving lane toward **Thing's Eject**. A soft plunge that just crests the ramp drops into Thing's Eject for the skill shot: 2M the first time, +1M per consecutive success, capping at 5M.
